body.en: A chromosome is an organized DNA molecule with associated proteins; eukaryotic chromosomes are usually linear and located in a nucleus. A genome is a system’s complete hereditary information. A gene is a DNA region whose expression produces a functional RNA or, through RNA, a protein product; not every gene codes for a protein. Most DNA in a complex genome is not a simple uninterrupted list of protein instructions, and regulation affects which regions are used.
body.zh: 染色体是有组织的 DNA 分子及其结合蛋白；真核染色体通常呈线状，位于细胞核中。基因组指一个系统的完整遗传信息。基因是其表达可产生有功能 RNA，或通过 RNA 产生蛋白质产物的 DNA 区域；并非每个基因都编码蛋白质。复杂基因组中的 DNA 不是一串简单、连续的蛋白质指令，调控会影响哪些区域被使用。

title.zh: 互补性使复制成为可能

body.en: Opposite an aligned DNA segment A C G T T A, the complementary bases are T G C A A T. During replication, the strands separate and each guides construction of a complementary strand. Each resulting double-stranded DNA molecule contains one old strand and one new strand: semiconservative replication. Enzymes perform the work and correct many errors, but copying is not perfect. A mutation is a change in sequence, not necessarily a visible or harmful trait.
body.zh: 与一段按位置对齐的 DNA 序列 A C G T T A 相配对的碱基为 T G C A A T。复制时，两条链分开，各自指导互补链的构建。每个新双链 DNA 分子都含一条旧链和一条新链，称为半保留复制。酶完成这些过程并校正许多错误，但复制并非绝对无误。突变是序列的改变，不一定表现为可见或有害性状。

body.en: Transcription makes RNA using a DNA template; RNA uses U in place of T. For a protein-coding gene, messenger RNA can be read by a ribosome during translation. Groups of three RNA bases, codons, specify amino acids or stop signals under a genetic code. Amino acids join into a chain that folds and may be modified into a functional protein. DNA is not turned physically into protein; information guides synthesis using available molecules.
body.zh: 转录以 DNA 为模板合成 RNA，RNA 用 U 代替 T。对于编码蛋白质的基因，信使 RNA 在翻译中由核糖体读取。每三个 RNA 碱基组成一个密码子，按遗传密码指定氨基酸或终止信号。氨基酸连接成链，折叠并可能经过修饰后成为有功能的蛋白质。DNA 并不是在物质上直接变成蛋白质，而是其信息指导利用现有分子进行合成。

title.en: A gene is not a complete destiny
title.zh: 基因不是完整的命运决定书

body.en: Many traits depend on multiple genes, regulation, development and environment. A sequence change can have no detectable effect, alter expression or change a protein; effects depend on context. Cells in one organism can carry much of the same DNA yet use different genes, helping produce different cell types. Replication copies DNA, transcription makes RNA and translation builds protein. Keeping those verbs separate prevents a common confusion about what is copied and what is made.
body.zh: 许多性状由多个基因、调控、发育过程和环境共同影响。序列变化可能没有可检测的影响，也可能改变表达或蛋白质，结果依赖具体情境。同一生物体的细胞可以携带大体相同的 DNA，却使用不同基因，从而形成不同细胞类型。复制拷贝 DNA，转录制造 RNA，翻译构建蛋白质。区分这些动词，可避免把被复制的东西与被合成的东西混为一谈。

prompt.en: What bases pair opposite the aligned DNA segment A T C G? Read each answer left-to-right under the given segment, not as a separately oriented strand.
prompt.zh: 与按位置排列的 DNA 片段 A T C G 相对的碱基是什么？按原片段下方从左到右读取选项，不改变链的方向。

text.en: T A G C
text.zh: T A G C

text.en: A T C G
text.zh: A T C G

text.en: U A G C
text.zh: U A G C

hints.en: For DNA, pair A with T and C with G.
hints.zh: DNA 中 A 配 T，C 配 G。

explanation.en: Each aligned base has its complement: A→T, T→A, C→G, G→C. U is used in RNA, not in standard DNA pairing.
explanation.zh: 逐个配对：A→T，T→A，C→G，G→C。U 用于 RNA，而不是通常的 DNA 配对。

prompt.en: A ribosome reads messenger RNA and builds an amino-acid chain. Which process is this?
prompt.zh: 核糖体读取信使 RNA，并构建氨基酸链。这是什么过程？

text.en: DNA replication.
text.zh: DNA 复制。

text.en: Transcription.
text.zh: 转录。

text.en: Translation.
text.zh: 翻译。

hints.en: Name the product: an amino-acid chain, not RNA or DNA.
hints.zh: 注意产物是氨基酸链，不是 RNA 或 DNA。

explanation.en: Translation reads RNA codons to assemble an amino-acid chain. Transcription makes RNA from a template; replication copies DNA.
explanation.zh: 翻译读取 RNA 密码子，组装氨基酸链。转录以模板合成 RNA，复制则拷贝 DNA。

prompt.en: In a double-stranded DNA sample, 30% of bases are A. What percentage are C under standard complementary pairing?
prompt.zh: 某双链 DNA 样品中，A 占全部碱基的 30%。按通常的互补配对，C 占百分之几？输入百分数数值。

hints.en: A and T counts match; C and G counts match.
hints.zh: A 与 T 数量相等，C 与 G 数量相等。

hints.en: After A and T account for 60%, divide the remaining 40% equally.
hints.zh: A 和 T 共占 60%，剩余 40% 在 C 和 G 之间平分。

explanation.en: T is 30%, leaving 40% for C and G together. Their equal counts give C = 20%. The argument requires the double-stranded sample assumption.
explanation.zh: T 占 30%，C 与 G 共占剩余 40%，两者相等，因此 C 占 20%。推理依赖样品为双链 DNA 的条件。

title.zh: 遗传：等位基因、减数分裂与概率

summary.en: Derive a Mendelian cross from gametes and explicit model assumptions.
summary.zh: 从配子与明确的模型假设出发，推导孟德尔遗传组合。

objectives.en: Distinguish genotype, phenotype and allele.
objectives.zh: 区分基因型、表现型与等位基因。

objectives.en: Explain why a gamete receives one allele at a simple diploid locus.
objectives.zh: 解释在简单双倍体位点模型中，配子为什么得到一个等位基因。

objectives.en: Calculate a monohybrid outcome without treating probability as a guarantee.
objectives.zh: 计算单因子杂交结果，并区分概率与保证。

title.zh: 同一位置上的不同版本

body.en: A locus is a location in the genome; an allele is a variant at that locus. In a simple diploid model, an organism has two homologous chromosome sets, one inherited from each parent, and therefore two alleles at the locus. AA and aa are homozygous; Aa is heterozygous. The genotype names the allele combination. The phenotype is the observed trait, influenced by genotype and sometimes environment and other genes.
body.zh: 基因座是基因组中的一个位置，等位基因是在该位置上的不同版本。在简单双倍体模型中，生物有两套同源染色体，分别来自双亲，因此某个位点有两个等位基因。AA 和 aa 是纯合，Aa 是杂合。基因型描述等位基因组合，表现型则是观察到的性状，它受基因型影响，有时也受环境和其他基因影响。

title.en: Why gametes have one copy in this model
title.zh: 为什么配子在这个模型中只有一份

body.en: Meiosis reduces chromosome sets when producing haploid cells used in sexual reproduction. DNA is copied once, then two divisions separate homologous chromosomes and subsequently sister chromatids. A gamete from an Aa individual receives A or a, with probability 1/2 each in the simple segregation model. Fertilization combines two gametes to restore the diploid state. Ordinary mitotic cell division instead usually preserves chromosome-set number.
body.zh: 减数分裂减少染色体组数，产生用于有性生殖的单倍体细胞。DNA 先复制一次，再经过两次分裂，先分离同源染色体，随后分离姐妹染色单体。简单分离模型中，Aa 个体的配子得到 A 或 a，各以 1/2 的概率出现。受精结合两个配子，恢复双倍体状态。普通有丝分裂则通常保持染色体组数不变。

body.en: Cross Aa with Aa. Each parent contributes A or a independently with probability 1/2. Multiplication gives AA, A from first with a from second, a from first with A from second, and aa, each with probability 1/4. The two middle outcomes share genotype Aa, so genotype probabilities are AA: 1/4, Aa: 1/2, aa: 1/4. A Punnett square organizes these combinations; its equal-sized boxes are justified only by the specified equal gamete probabilities.
body.zh: Aa 与 Aa 杂交时，每个亲本都以 1/2 的概率独立贡献 A 或 a。按乘法规则，AA、第一亲本 A 与第二亲本 a、第一亲本 a 与第二亲本 A，以及 aa，各有 1/4 的概率。中间两项基因型都为 Aa，所以 AA、Aa、aa 的概率分别为 1/4、1/2、1/4。棋盘格整理的是这些组合；格子等概率依赖题设中配子等概率的条件。

title.en: Dominant does not mean stronger or more common
title.zh: 显性不代表更强或更常见

body.en: Under complete dominance, Aa has the same scored phenotype as AA, giving a 3/4 dominant-phenotype probability in that cross. Dominance describes the heterozygote’s phenotype, not an allele’s frequency, fitness or ability to erase another allele. Incomplete dominance, codominance, multiple genes and environmental effects require other models. Independent assortment across different loci also needs conditions; nearby loci on a chromosome can be linked.
body.zh: 完全显性模型中，Aa 与 AA 的所观察表现型相同，因此刚才杂交中显性表现型的概率为 3/4。显性描述杂合子的表现型，不表示等位基因更常见、更适应环境，或能抹去另一个等位基因。不完全显性、共显性、多基因与环境影响需要其他模型。不同位点的独立分配也有条件，同一染色体上相近位点可能发生连锁。

title.zh: 概率预测分布，而不是承诺

body.en: A 1/4 probability of aa does not guarantee exactly one aa among four offspring. If separate offspring are independent under the model, the next outcome remains 1/4 even after several aa offspring. Expected counts equal probability times sample size, while observed counts fluctuate. Use data to assess a model, and consider sample size before rejecting it. This model is a teaching framework, not a prediction of a complex human trait from one letter pair.
body.zh: aa 的概率为 1/4，不保证四个后代中恰有一个 aa。若模型中不同后代相互独立，即使此前连续出现多个 aa，下一个仍有 1/4 的概率。期望数量等于概率乘以样本数，而实际数量会波动。应使用数据评估模型，并在否定模型前考虑样本量。这是教学模型，不能用一对字母预测复杂的人类性状。

prompt.en: Under equal segregation and independent fertilization, what is the probability of aa from Aa × Aa? Enter a decimal from 0 to 1.
prompt.zh: 在等概率分离、配子独立结合的条件下，Aa × Aa 产生 aa 的概率是多少？输入 0 到 1 的小数。

hints.en: Both parents must contribute a.
hints.zh: 两个亲本都必须贡献 a。

hints.en: Multiply 1/2 by 1/2.

explanation.en: P(aa) = (1/2)(1/2) = 1/4 = 0.25. A phenotype assumption is not needed to compute this genotype probability.
explanation.zh: P(aa) = (1/2)(1/2) = 1/4 = 0.25。计算这个基因型概率，不需要先假设显隐性表现。

prompt.en: For Aa × aa under the same model, what fraction of offspring are Aa? Enter a decimal.
prompt.zh: 在相同模型下，Aa × aa 的后代中，Aa 的比例期望为多少？输入小数。

hints.en: The aa parent always contributes a.
hints.zh: aa 亲本总是贡献 a。

hints.en: The Aa parent contributes A half the time.
hints.zh: Aa 亲本有一半概率贡献 A。

explanation.en: The outcomes are Aa and aa, each with probability 1/2. Thus the expected fraction of Aa is 0.5.
explanation.zh: 后代可能为 Aa 或 aa，各有 1/2 的概率，因此 Aa 的期望比例为 0.5。

prompt.en: Two Aa parents already had three aa offspring. Under independent offspring in the same model, what is the next offspring’s aa probability?
prompt.zh: 两个 Aa 亲本已有三个 aa 后代。在各次后代独立、模型不变时，下一个后代为 aa 的概率是多少？

text.en: Zero: the aa quota is used up.
text.zh: 零：aa 的名额已经用完。

text.en: One quarter.
text.zh: 四分之一。

text.en: One: the parents can only produce aa.
text.zh: 一：亲本只能产生 aa。

hints.en: Independence means earlier outcomes do not change this probability.
hints.zh: 独立意味着此前结果不改变本次概率。

explanation.en: It remains 1/4 under the stated model. Earlier outcomes may motivate checking model assumptions, but they do not force future outcomes to compensate.
explanation.zh: 在题设模型下仍为 1/4。先前结果可以促使我们检查模型假设，却不会强迫未来结果进行补偿。

summary.en: Turn a task into exact, executable instructions.
summary.zh: 把任务变成精确、可执行的指令。

objectives.en: Separate a problem, an algorithm, and a program.
objectives.zh: 区分问题、算法和程序。

objectives.en: Trace instructions in their stated order.
objectives.zh: 按给定顺序跟踪指令。

body.en: A problem specifies what result is wanted. An algorithm describes a finite method for obtaining that result. A program expresses such a method in a language a computer can execute. The computer does not infer your intention when a step is missing. An input is information supplied to the program; an output is the information it produces.
body.zh: 问题说明想得到什么结果，算法描述得到结果的有限方法，程序把方法写成计算机能够执行的语言。缺少步骤时，计算机不会自动理解你的意图。输入是提供给程序的信息，输出是程序产生的信息。

body.en: State is the information currently remembered by a computation. To follow an algorithm, record the state after each instruction. “Start with 3; add 2; multiply by 4” gives 3, then 5, then 20. Changing the order to multiply before adding gives 14. Instructions are not an unordered list of wishes.
body.zh: 状态是计算过程当前保存的信息。跟踪算法时，要记录每一步之后的状态。“从 3 开始，加 2，再乘 4”的状态依次是 3、5、20。先乘 4 再加 2 则得到 14。指令不是可以随意交换顺序的愿望清单。

body.en: The accompanying example includes the input/output library, starts execution in main, reads two whole-number values, and prints their sum. The semicolon ends a statement. The braces group the statements in main. A compiler translates the source into another executable representation and reports certain language errors; compiling successfully does not prove the algorithm correct.
body.zh: 旁边的示例包含输入输出库，从 main 开始执行，读入两个整数，然后输出它们的和。分号结束一条语句，花括号把 main 中的语句组织在一起。编译器把源程序翻译成可执行形式，并报告某些语言错误；编译成功并不证明算法正确。

body.en: Before coding, state what inputs are permitted and what each output means. Does “add two numbers” mean whole numbers or decimals? How large can they be? What should happen if input is missing? In these first examples, assume valid input and values small enough to fit in the stated type. Later lessons remove those simplifications.
body.zh: 写程序前，要说明输入允许什么、输出表示什么。“两个数相加”是整数还是小数？数有多大？输入缺失时怎么办？最初的例子假定输入合法，数值足够小、不会超出类型范围；后续课程再逐步去掉这些简化。

prompt.en: Start with 4, add 3, then multiply by 2. What is the final value?
prompt.zh: 从 4 开始，加 3，再乘 2，最终是多少？

hints.en: Record the value after each step.
hints.zh: 记录每一步后的值。

explanation.en: 4 → 7 → 14. Multiplication acts on the updated value 7.
explanation.zh: 4 → 7 → 14。乘法作用于已经更新的 7。

prompt.en: Which statement specifies an output most precisely?
prompt.zh: 哪一句最精确地规定了输出？

text.en: Make the answer sensible.
text.zh: 让答案合理。

text.en: Print the sum of the two input integers.
text.zh: 输出两个输入整数的和。

text.en: Use a fast computer.
text.zh: 使用速度快的计算机。

hints.en: A specification tells us which result counts as correct.
hints.zh: 规范必须说明什么结果才算正确。

explanation.en: The sum is a defined mathematical result. The other statements do not identify a required output.
explanation.zh: “和”是明确的数学结果，另两句没有确定必须输出什么。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Understand how a program remembers and changes values.
summary.zh: 理解程序怎样保存和改变数值。

objectives.en: Trace assignments without treating them as algebraic equations.
objectives.zh: 跟踪赋值，不把赋值误当作代数等式。

objectives.en: Distinguish integer and real-number computations.
objectives.zh: 区分整数运算与实数运算。

title.en: A named value with a type

body.en: A variable names a stored value. In C++, int count = 3; creates an integer variable initialized to 3. A type determines the allowed kind of value and the meaning of operations. double stores a floating-point approximation to many real numbers; it does not store every decimal exactly. Initialization supplies the starting value before the program reads it.
body.zh: 变量为存储的值命名。C++ 中 int count = 3; 创建一个初始值为 3 的整数变量。类型决定允许的数值种类及运算含义。double 用浮点数近似表示许多实数，并不能精确保存所有小数。初始化在读取变量之前提供起始值。

body.en: The statement x = x + 2; first evaluates the right side using the old x, then replaces the stored x. It is not the impossible algebraic claim x equals x plus two. Equality testing uses == in C++. A variable can therefore have different values at different moments.
body.zh: x = x + 2; 先用旧的 x 计算右边，再替换保存的 x。这不是代数中不可能成立的“x 等于 x 加二”。C++ 使用 == 检查相等。因此同一个变量在不同时刻可以有不同的值。

body.en: For x = 5; y = x + 1; x = 9;, the final values are x = 9 and y = 6. Assigning x to an expression does not make y a permanently linked algebraic formula. The right side was evaluated when y received its value.
body.zh: 执行 x = 5; y = x + 1; x = 9; 后，x = 9、y = 6。给 y 赋值时右边已经计算完成，并没有让 y 永久绑定成一个随 x 改变的代数公式。

body.en: With nonnegative integers, 7 / 2 produces the integer quotient 3, while 7 % 2 produces the remainder 1. The expression 7.0 / 2 gives a floating-point approximation to 3.5. Integer types also have finite ranges. Signed overflow and division by zero are not valid ways to implement mathematical arithmetic.
body.zh: 对非负整数，7 / 2 得到整数商 3，7 % 2 得到余数 1。7.0 / 2 则得到 3.5 的浮点表示。整数类型的范围也有限；有符号溢出和除以零不能当作正常的数学运算来使用。

prompt.en: After x = 4; y = x * 2; x = 7;, what is y?
prompt.zh: 执行 x = 4; y = x * 2; x = 7; 后，y 是多少？

hints.en: Evaluate x * 2 at the assignment to y.
hints.zh: 在给 y 赋值的时刻计算 x * 2。

explanation.en: y receives 4 × 2 = 8 and is never assigned again.
explanation.zh: y 得到 4 × 2 = 8，之后没有再次赋值。

prompt.en: What does 11 % 4 produce for nonnegative C++ integers?
prompt.zh: 对非负 C++ 整数，11 % 4 得到多少？

hints.en: Write 11 as a multiple of 4 plus a smaller remainder.
hints.zh: 把 11 写成 4 的倍数加较小的余数。

explanation.en: 11 = 2 × 4 + 3, so the remainder is 3.

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Express a decision using true/false statements.
summary.zh: 用真假命题表达程序决策。

objectives.en: Evaluate comparisons and Boolean combinations.
objectives.zh: 计算比较和布尔组合的结果。

objectives.en: Choose correct boundary conditions.
objectives.zh: 正确处理边界条件。

title.en: A condition has a truth value

body.en: A comparison such as score >= 60 evaluates to true or false. An if statement executes its body only when its condition is true; an else branch handles the alternative. Conditions can depend on input. The same program may therefore take different paths on different runs.
body.zh: score >= 60 这样的比较结果为真或假。if 只在条件为真时执行对应语句，else 处理另一种情况。条件可以依赖输入，因此同一个程序在不同运行中可以经过不同路径。

body.en: A && B is true only when both A and B are true. A || B is true when at least one is true, including when both are true. !A reverses the truth value. In C++, these operators short-circuit: the second operand is evaluated only when needed to determine the result.
body.zh: A && B 要求 A、B 同时为真。A || B 要求至少一个为真，也包括两个都为真。!A 把真假反转。C++ 的这些运算会短路：只有确实需要第二项才能确定结果时，才计算第二项。

body.en: To recognize x in the closed interval from 3 to 8, write x >= 3 && x <= 8. The endpoints satisfy the condition. For the open interval, replace >= and <= with > and <. Do not write 3 <= x <= 8 in C++: unlike a mathematical chained inequality, it first compares 3 with x and then compares the resulting Boolean value with 8.
body.zh: 要判断 x 位于闭区间 [3,8]，写 x >= 3 && x <= 8，端点也满足条件。开区间则使用 > 和 <。不要在 C++ 中写 3 <= x <= 8；它不是数学中的连锁不等式，而是先比较 3 和 x，再把得到的布尔值与 8 比较。

body.en: Most branching errors occur near a boundary or when two conditions overlap. For a threshold at 60, test 59, 60, and 61. For an empty/nonempty container, test size 0 and size 1. These cases are chosen because they distinguish the intended rule from plausible incorrect rules.
body.zh: 分支错误常出现在边界附近或条件重叠时。阈值为 60，就测试 59、60、61；区分空容器和非空容器，就测试大小为 0、1 的情况。这些测试可以区分正确规则和看似合理的错误规则。

prompt.en: At x = 3, is x > 3 && x < 8 true?
prompt.zh: x = 3 时，x > 3 && x < 8 为真吗？

text.en: True
text.zh: 真

text.en: False
text.zh: 假

hints.en: The first comparison is strict.
hints.zh: 第一个比较是严格大于。

explanation.en: 3 > 3 is false, so the conjunction is false.
explanation.zh: 3 > 3 为假，因此整个与条件为假。

prompt.en: Which condition describes being outside [3,8]?
prompt.zh: 哪个条件表示不在 [3,8] 内？

hints.en: Being outside can happen on either side.
hints.zh: 区间的左边或右边都属于外部。

explanation.en: A value is outside if it is below 3 or above 8. It cannot be on both sides simultaneously.
explanation.zh: 小于 3 或大于 8 都是外部，一个数不可能同时在两侧。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Describe repetition with a changing state and a stopping rule.
summary.zh: 用变化的状态和停止规则描述重复。

objectives.en: Trace a loop including its condition checks.
objectives.zh: 跟踪循环及其条件检查。

objectives.en: Explain why a loop terminates.
objectives.zh: 说明循环为什么会终止。

body.en: A loop needs an initial state, a condition for continuing, and an update that changes the state. A while loop tests the condition before each iteration. If the condition is false initially, the body runs zero times. A for loop packages initialization, condition, and update in one header.
body.zh: 循环需要初始状态、继续条件和改变状态的更新。while 在每轮开始前检查条件；如果一开始条件就为假，循环体执行零次。for 把初始化、条件和更新放在一个循环头中。

title.en: Build a sum one term at a time

body.en: For the sum 1 + 2 + 3 + 4, initialize sum = 0. At iteration i, add i. After i = 1,2,3,4, the accumulated values are 1,3,6,10. Zero is the additive starting value because adding it does not alter the result. A product would instead start at 1.
body.zh: 计算 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 时，先令 sum = 0，每轮把 i 加进去。i 依次为 1、2、3、4 时，累计值依次为 1、3、6、10。零是加法的起点，因为加零不改变结果；连乘则应从 1 开始。

title.zh: 终止是正确性的一部分

body.en: For i starting at 1 and increasing by 1 while i <= n, a fixed nonnegative n bounds the number of iterations. Assuming representable arithmetic, eventually i becomes n + 1 and the condition fails. A program that never stops has not solved a task that requires a finite answer.
body.zh: i 从 1 开始，每次增加 1，在 i <= n 时继续。固定的非负 n 限定了轮数；在运算不溢出的前提下，i 最终到达 n + 1，使条件变为假。要求有限答案的任务，不能被永不停止的程序解决。

body.en: To process array positions 0 through n−1, use i < n, not i <= n. To sum integers 1 through n, use i <= n. The correct comparison depends on the meaning of the index, not on a memorized template. Trace the empty case and the one-element case.
body.zh: 处理数组位置 0 到 n−1，应使用 i < n；累加整数 1 到 n，则使用 i <= n。正确比较取决于下标的意义，而不是背诵模板。要检查空情况和只有一个元素的情况。

prompt.en: How many times does for (int i=0; i<5; ++i) execute its body?
prompt.zh: for (int i=0; i<5; ++i) 的循环体执行几次？

hints.en: List the values for which i < 5 is true.
hints.zh: 列出满足 i < 5 的下标。

explanation.en: The body sees i = 0,1,2,3,4: five iterations.
explanation.zh: 循环体看到 i = 0、1、2、3、4，共五轮。

prompt.en: Starting with sum=0, add i for each i from 1 through 5. What is sum?
prompt.zh: sum 从 0 开始，依次加上 1 到 5，结果是多少？

hints.en: Record the partial sums.
hints.zh: 记录部分和。

explanation.en: The partial sums are 1,3,6,10,15.

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Give a computation a clear input, output, and contract.
summary.zh: 为计算明确输入、输出与约定。

objectives.en: Explain parameters, return values, and local variables.
objectives.zh: 说明参数、返回值和局部变量。

objectives.en: State a function contract.
objectives.zh: 写出函数的输入输出约定。

body.en: A function groups a computation so it can be called from several places. Parameters name the values supplied by the caller. A return statement provides a result and ends the function call. A function returning int must return an appropriate integer value on every reachable path that needs a result.
body.zh: 函数把计算组织起来，以便在多处调用。参数为调用者提供的值命名，return 提供结果并结束这次调用。返回 int 的函数，在需要结果的每条可到达路径上，都必须返回恰当的整数值。

body.en: The function int square(int x) { return x * x; } receives a copy of its integer argument and returns its square. square(3) returns 9. Its local name x is separate from an unrelated x in another scope. This function is valid only for input sizes whose square fits the return type.
body.zh: int square(int x) { return x * x; } 接收整数实参的一个副本，返回它的平方。square(3) 返回 9。局部名称 x 与其他作用域中的同名变量不同。这个函数只适用于平方仍能装入返回类型的输入范围。

body.en: A contract states the allowed inputs and promised result. To solve a larger task, split it into functions whose contracts fit together. If one function promises a sorted sequence, the next may use binary search. If sorting was never established, the caller cannot assume it.
body.zh: 约定说明允许什么输入、保证什么结果。解决大问题时，可以拆成若干约定彼此匹配的函数。如果前一个函数保证序列已经排序，后一个就能使用二分查找；从未建立排序条件时，调用者不能擅自假定它。

body.en: Printing sends characters to an output stream. Returning passes a value back to the caller. A function can print 9 yet return 0; the caller receives 0. Prefer a returned result for a reusable calculation, and let a separate part decide how to display it.
body.zh: 打印把字符送到输出流，返回则把值交给调用者。一个函数可以打印 9 却返回 0，调用者得到的是 0。可复用的计算通常返回结果，再由其他部分决定怎样显示。

prompt.en: For square(x)=x*x, what is square(4)+square(2)?
prompt.zh: square(x)=x*x 时，square(4)+square(2) 是多少？

hints.en: Evaluate each call separately.
hints.zh: 分别计算两次调用。

prompt.en: A function prints 7 and returns 3. Which value is assigned by int y = f();?
prompt.zh: 函数打印 7、返回 3，int y = f(); 给 y 赋什么值？

hints.en: Assignment receives the return value.
hints.zh: 赋值接收返回值。

explanation.en: The printed characters and returned value are different channels. y receives 3.
explanation.zh: 打印字符与返回值属于不同通道，y 得到 3。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Store many values and reason about their positions.
summary.zh: 存储多个值并理解它们的位置。

objectives.en: Distinguish a position from the value at that position.
objectives.zh: 区分位置与位置上的值。

objectives.en: Respect sequence boundaries.
objectives.zh: 遵守序列边界。

body.en: A sequence stores values in order. A C++ vector can represent a sequence whose length is known at runtime. For a = {8,3,6}, position 0 contains 8, position 1 contains 3, and position 2 contains 6. The size is 3, but position 3 is outside this sequence.
body.zh: 序列按顺序保存数值。C++ 的 vector 可以表示运行时才知道长度的序列。a = {8,3,6} 中，位置 0 保存 8，位置 1 保存 3，位置 2 保存 6。长度为 3，但位置 3 已经在序列之外。

body.en: For a nonempty sequence, start best at the first value, then compare each remaining value with best. In {8,3,6}, best remains 8. Starting best at 0 would be wrong for {-5,-2,-9}, whose maximum is -2. The initial state must reflect the input domain.
body.zh: 对非空序列，把 best 初始化为第一个值，再逐个比较剩余元素。{8,3,6} 的 best 最终为 8。若一开始令 best=0，则会错误处理 {-5,-2,-9}，因为其最大值是 -2。初始状态必须符合输入范围。

body.en: The index i describes where a value is stored; a[i] is the stored value itself. If a[2] = 6, neither i = 6 nor a[6] follows. To process every element once, range-based iteration is often clearer than manual indexing when the position is not needed.
body.zh: 下标 i 表示存储位置，a[i] 才是其中的值。a[2]=6 并不意味着 i=6，也不能据此访问 a[6]。如果不需要位置，用范围循环逐个处理元素往往比手动下标更清楚。

body.en: Accessing the first element requires that one exists. A maximum of an empty list is not an ordinary number unless the problem defines a special convention. Check the size, reject unsupported inputs, or return an optional result. Do not read invalid memory and hope it contains a convenient value.
body.zh: 访问第一个元素的前提是它存在。除非题目另有约定，空列表的最大值不是普通数值。应检查长度、拒绝不支持的输入，或返回可选结果；不能读取无效内存，再指望其中恰好是方便的数。

prompt.en: For a={4,9,2,7}, what is a[2]?

hints.en: Indexing starts at zero.
hints.zh: 下标从零开始。

explanation.en: Positions 0,1,2,3 contain 4,9,2,7 respectively.

prompt.en: What is the maximum of {-8,-3,-6}?

hints.en: The maximum must be an element of this nonempty list.
hints.zh: 非空列表的最大值必须是其中的某个元素。

explanation.en: -3 exceeds both -8 and -6. Initializing a candidate to 0 would create an answer absent from the list.
explanation.zh: -3 大于 -8 和 -6。把候选答案初始化为 0，会凭空制造列表中不存在的答案。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Explain why each iteration preserves the meaning of the computation.
summary.zh: 解释每轮循环如何保持计算的意义。

objectives.en: State and use initialization, preservation, and termination.
objectives.zh: 陈述并使用初始化、保持与终止。

objectives.en: Connect a loop invariant and the exit condition to the promised result.
objectives.zh: 把循环不变量与退出条件结合，推导程序承诺的结果。

body.en: A program is correct relative to a specification. Examples can disprove correctness when one fails, but passing several examples cannot usually prove correctness for all inputs. A proof describes why the logic works for every input in the declared domain.
body.zh: 程序的正确性是相对于规范而言的。一个失败例子可以否定正确性，但通常不能因为几个例子成功就证明对所有输入都正确。证明要说明逻辑为什么适用于声明范围内的每个输入。

title.en: An invariant is a maintained claim
title.zh: 不变量是持续成立的命题

body.en: A loop invariant states a property at a precise point in each iteration. Prove it before the first iteration, prove that one iteration preserves it, and combine it with the stopping condition to obtain the desired result. “The program works” is too vague to serve as an invariant.
body.zh: 循环不变量是在每轮某个明确位置成立的性质。先证明第一轮前成立，再证明一轮操作能保持，最后结合停止条件推出目标结果。“程序是对的”太笼统，不能作为不变量。

body.en: Before adding i in a loop over 1 through n, let the invariant be sum = 1 + ... + (i−1). Initially i=1 and sum=0, the empty sum. Adding i makes the sum equal 1+...+i; increasing i restores the invariant for the next iteration. On exit i=n+1, so sum=1+...+n.
body.zh: 在循环加上 i 之前，令不变量为 sum = 1 + ... + (i−1)。初始 i=1、sum=0，对应空和。加上 i 后得到 1+...+i，再增加 i，就恢复下一轮需要的形式。退出时 i=n+1，所以 sum=1+...+n。

body.en: An invariant alone does not show that execution ends. Supply a progress argument, such as an integer counter increasing toward a fixed bound. Also check that arithmetic cannot overflow under the stated constraints; a proof over mathematical integers may fail to describe actual machine operations.
body.zh: 仅有不变量不能证明程序结束，还需要进展论证，例如整数计数器不断逼近固定上界。也要根据约束检查运算是否溢出；在数学整数上成立的证明，不一定描述了真实机器上的运算。

prompt.en: Before adding i=4 in the sum loop, what should sum equal?
prompt.zh: 求和循环在加上 i=4 之前，sum 应是多少？

hints.en: The invariant covers terms strictly before i.
hints.zh: 不变量覆盖 i 之前的项。

explanation.en: sum = 1+2+3 = 6 before the fourth term.
explanation.zh: 加第四项之前，sum = 1+2+3 = 6。

prompt.en: Which observation disproves a claim of correctness on all allowed inputs?
prompt.zh: 哪种情况能否定“对所有合法输入正确”？

text.en: A hundred successful tests
text.zh: 一百次测试成功

text.en: One allowed input with a wrong output
text.zh: 一个合法输入得到错误输出

text.en: A fast runtime on one sample
text.zh: 一个样例运行很快

hints.en: A universal claim must survive every allowed case.
hints.zh: 全称命题必须对每个允许情况成立。

explanation.en: A single counterexample contradicts a universal correctness claim.
explanation.zh: 一个反例就足以否定全称正确性命题。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Count work as a function of input size before measuring seconds.
summary.zh: 先用输入规模描述工作量，再测量秒数。

objectives.en: Distinguish linear, quadratic, and logarithmic growth.
objectives.zh: 区分线性、平方和对数增长。

objectives.en: Estimate operation counts from a loop structure and state the cost model.
objectives.zh: 根据循环结构估算运算次数，并说明使用的代价模型。

body.en: Let n represent a clearly defined input size, such as the number of list elements. A running-time model counts basic operations as n changes. It abstracts away some hardware details so we can compare growth. Big-O is an asymptotic upper bound under a stated cost model, not an exact stopwatch reading.
body.zh: 用 n 表示明确定义的输入规模，例如列表元素个数。时间模型描述 n 变化时基本操作数量的变化，暂时抽去一些硬件细节以比较增长速度。大 O 是给定成本模型下的渐近上界，不是精确的秒表读数。

body.en: Visiting n elements once uses work proportional to n. Two independent loops each performing n iterations visit n² ordered pairs. At n=100, that is 100 versus 10,000 visits. A nested loop whose inner limit depends on the outer index needs its own sum; not every pair of nested loops is exactly n².
body.zh: 一次访问 n 个元素，工作量与 n 成正比。两个各执行 n 轮的独立嵌套循环，会访问 n² 个有序数对。n=100 时分别是 100 和 10,000 次。内层界限依赖外层下标时，需要另行求和，不能把所有双层循环都当成恰好 n²。

body.en: If each step reduces the remaining possibilities by about half, the number of steps grows logarithmically. Starting from 16 possibilities, four halvings leave one. This is why binary search can be efficient, provided its sorted-order requirement is satisfied.
body.zh: 如果每步把剩余可能性约减半，步骤数呈对数增长。16 个可能经过四次减半后剩一个。这解释了二分查找的效率，但前提是满足有序要求。

body.en: Specify worst-case, average-case, or amortized behavior. Specify additional sizes when needed: a graph may have V vertices and E edges. An O(n²) algorithm can still outperform a complex O(n log n) implementation for small n; growth and measured performance answer different questions.
body.zh: 要说明是最坏、平均还是摊还情况。必要时引入多个规模，例如图有 V 个顶点、E 条边。对很小的 n，简单的 O(n²) 算法也可能快过复杂的 O(n log n) 实现；增长率和实测性能回答不同问题。

prompt.en: Two independent loops each run 8 times, one inside the other. How many body executions occur?
prompt.zh: 两个独立循环各运行 8 次，彼此嵌套，内层循环体共执行几次？

hints.en: Each outer iteration contains all 8 inner iterations.
hints.zh: 每轮外层循环都包含完整的 8 轮内层循环。

prompt.en: How many exact halvings reduce 32 to 1?
prompt.zh: 把 32 精确减半多少次后得到 1？

hints.en: List the remaining sizes.
hints.zh: 列出每次剩余的规模。

explanation.en: 32 → 16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → 1 takes five halvings.

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Discard only candidates that have been proved impossible.
summary.zh: 只排除已经证明不可能的候选。

objectives.en: Explain the sorted-order assumption and interval update.
objectives.zh: 解释有序前提和区间更新。

objectives.en: Trace an unsuccessful search and identify why the candidate interval becomes empty.
objectives.zh: 跟踪查找失败的情况，解释候选区间为何最终变空。

body.en: In an ascending sorted sequence, comparing a middle value with the target tells us which half cannot contain the target. If the middle value is too small, every earlier value is also too small. Without sorted order, that inference fails. Binary search depends on this logical structure, not merely on choosing a midpoint.
body.zh: 在升序序列中，把中间值与目标比较，就知道哪一半不可能含有目标。如果中间值太小，之前的每个值也都太小；没有排序时，这个推理不成立。二分查找依赖的是这种逻辑结构，而不只是“取中点”。

body.en: Search for 9 in [1,3,5,7,9,11,13]. The middle value is 7, so eliminate it and everything before it. Search [9,11,13]; 11 is too large, leaving [9]. The answer is original index 4. A trace should distinguish original indices from positions in the remaining display.
body.zh: 在 [1,3,5,7,9,11,13] 中找 9。中间值 7 太小，排除它及之前所有值。剩下 [9,11,13]，中间值 11 太大，再剩 [9]。答案是原下标 4。跟踪时要区分原下标与剩余列表中的显示位置。

body.en: For a first index with value at least target, maintain a half-open candidate interval [lo,hi). When a[mid] < target, set lo=mid+1; otherwise set hi=mid. Stop at lo=hi. Returning n means every element was smaller. This is a lower-bound problem, distinct from merely asking whether an exact match exists.
body.zh: 寻找第一个不小于 target 的位置时，维护半开候选区间 [lo,hi)。若 a[mid] < target，则令 lo=mid+1，否则令 hi=mid。lo=hi 时结束。返回 n 表示所有元素都更小。这是 lower bound 问题，与单纯判断是否存在相等元素有所区别。

body.en: Each update must strictly reduce a nonempty interval. Reusing mid as a lower boundary without the right convention can leave the interval unchanged. Compute mid as lo + (hi-lo)/2 when the integer bounds make this expression safe. Check empty input, one element, duplicates, and an absent target.
body.zh: 每次更新必须严格缩小非空区间。约定不合适时直接把下界改成 mid，可能使区间不变。在整数边界允许时，使用 lo + (hi-lo)/2 计算中点。检查空输入、单元素、重复元素和不存在目标等情况。

prompt.en: In [2,4,4,8], what is the first zero-based index whose value is at least 4?
prompt.zh: 在 [2,4,4,8] 中，第一个不小于 4 的零起始下标是多少？

hints.en: The first occurrence matters.
hints.zh: 需要找到第一次满足的位置。

explanation.en: Index 0 holds 2; index 1 holds 4 and is the first qualifying position.
explanation.zh: 下标 0 保存 2，下标 1 保存 4，首次满足条件。

prompt.en: Why may values left of a too-small midpoint be discarded?
prompt.zh: 为什么中点太小时，可以排除它左边的值？

text.en: They are earlier in memory.
text.zh: 它们在内存中更早。

text.en: Ascending order makes them no larger than the midpoint.
text.zh: 升序保证它们不大于中点。

text.en: They have already been individually tested.
text.zh: 它们已经逐个测试过。

hints.en: Identify the assumption that justifies the exclusion.
hints.zh: 找出支持排除结论的前提。

explanation.en: Sorted order establishes that every value on that side is too small as well.
explanation.zh: 排序保证那一侧的所有值也都太小。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Represent objects and their connections without assuming a geometric picture.
summary.zh: 表示对象及联系，不把画法误当作定义。

objectives.en: Distinguish vertices, edges, paths, and directed relationships.
objectives.zh: 区分顶点、边、路径与有向关系。

objectives.en: Translate a small relationship model into adjacency data without relying on its drawing.
objectives.zh: 把小型关系模型转换为邻接数据，而不依赖图的画法。

body.en: A graph consists of vertices and edges. Vertices represent objects; edges represent a chosen relationship. Cities and roads form one example, lessons and prerequisites another. An edge may be directed when the relationship has an order. A prerequisite arrow from A to B means A is required before B, not that B is required before A.
body.zh: 图由顶点和边组成。顶点表示对象，边表示选定的关系，例如城市与道路、课程与先修知识。有顺序的关系需要有向边。先修箭头 A→B 表示 B 需要 A，并不表示 A 也需要 B。

body.en: A path follows edges from one vertex to another, respecting directions when present. A vertex is reachable if such a sequence exists. A cycle returns to its starting vertex. Required-knowledge relationships should not form a cycle, or every item in the cycle would demand another before anyone can begin.
body.zh: 路径沿着边从一个顶点到另一个顶点；有方向时必须遵守方向。存在这样的序列就称为可达。环会回到起点。必要先修关系不应形成环，否则环中每项都要求先学另一项，无法开始。

body.en: Let arithmetic → equations, equations → functions, and functions → derivatives. Arithmetic is an indirect prerequisite of derivatives even without a direct edge. If vectors is a separate root, it need not precede these particular lessons unless an explicit dependency is added. Connections should explain actual assumptions, not just topical similarity.
body.zh: 设算术→方程、方程→函数、函数→导数。即使没有直接边，算术也是导数的间接先修。如果向量是独立根节点，就不能仅因主题相关而要求先学向量。依赖必须反映实际前提，而不是话题相似。

body.en: Moving a vertex on screen does not change the graph. Crossing drawn edges do not create a vertex unless one is specified. Distinguish a required edge from a related-topic link; the latter may form cycles without making the prerequisite system inconsistent.
body.zh: 移动屏幕上的顶点不会改变图。两条线在图上交叉，也不会自动产生新顶点。必须区分必要依赖和相关话题链接；后者可以形成环，而不破坏先修系统的一致性。

prompt.en: In A→B→C→D, how many edges are followed from A to D?
prompt.zh: 在 A→B→C→D 中，从 A 到 D 经过几条边？

hints.en: Count connections, not vertices.
hints.zh: 数连接，不是数顶点。

explanation.en: The path uses A→B, B→C, and C→D: three edges.
explanation.zh: 路径使用 A→B、B→C、C→D，共三条边。

prompt.en: Which is a prerequisite cycle?
prompt.zh: 哪个构成先修环？

text.en: A→B and B→C
text.zh: A→B，B→C

text.en: A→B and B→A
text.zh: A→B，B→A

text.en: A→B and A→C
text.zh: A→B，A→C

hints.en: Can following arrows return to the start?
hints.zh: 沿箭头能否回到起点？

explanation.en: A→B→A returns to A and demands each lesson before the other.
explanation.zh: A→B→A 回到 A，导致两门课互相要求先学对方。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

title.zh: 从基本原理理解动态规划

summary.en: Name smaller problems so their answers can be reused correctly.
summary.zh: 给子问题命名，从而正确复用答案。

objectives.en: Define a state, base cases, and a complete transition.
objectives.zh: 定义状态、初始情况与完整转移。

objectives.en: Choose a computation order in which each transition uses already available subproblem answers.
objectives.zh: 安排计算顺序，保证转移使用的子问题答案已经得到。

body.en: Dynamic programming stores answers to subproblems instead of recomputing them each time. The essential step is the meaning of a state. “dp[i] is useful” is not a definition. “dp[i] is the number of ordered ways to climb exactly i steps using moves of size 1 or 2” is a precise definition.
body.zh: 动态规划保存子问题的答案，避免反复计算。关键是说明状态的含义。“dp[i] 很有用”不是定义；“dp[i] 表示每次走 1 或 2 级，恰好登上 i 级台阶的有序走法数”才是精确定义。

body.en: A route to step i ends with either a 1-step move from i−1 or a 2-step move from i−2. These possibilities are disjoint and exhaust all routes, so dp[i]=dp[i−1]+dp[i−2] for i≥2. Set dp[0]=1 for the empty route and dp[1]=1. Then dp[2]=2 and dp[3]=3.
body.zh: 到达 i 级的走法，最后一步要么从 i−1 走 1 级，要么从 i−2 走 2 级。这两类互不重叠，并覆盖全部走法，所以 i≥2 时 dp[i]=dp[i−1]+dp[i−2]。令 dp[0]=1 表示空走法，dp[1]=1，于是 dp[2]=2、dp[3]=3。

title.zh: 先计算依赖，再计算当前状态

body.en: Each state depends on smaller indices, so compute in increasing order. The dependency graph is acyclic. This connects DP to the course atlas: an ordering is useful because every required earlier result is ready when it is used. Storage can sometimes be reduced after identifying which previous states remain necessary.
body.zh: 每个状态依赖更小的下标，因此按递增顺序计算。依赖图没有环。这与课程地图相似：使用一个先前结果时，它已经准备好。明确仍需保留哪些旧状态后，有时还可以减少存储空间。

body.en: Here 1+2 and 2+1 are different ordered routes. If the task asks for unordered collections of moves, this recurrence counts the wrong objects. Explain why transitions neither omit cases nor count the same object twice. State whether exact integers or residues modulo a number are required.
body.zh: 这里 1+2 和 2+1 是不同的有序走法。如果题目要求无序的步长组合，这个递推就在统计错误对象。必须解释转移为何不遗漏、不重复，并明确需要精确整数还是模某个数的余数。

prompt.en: How many ordered routes reach step 4 using steps of size 1 or 2?
prompt.zh: 每次走 1 或 2 级，到第 4 级共有多少种有序走法？

hints.en: Use dp[2]=2 and dp[3]=3.

prompt.en: Why is dp[0]=1 in this counting model?
prompt.zh: 为什么这个计数模型中 dp[0]=1？

text.en: There is one empty sequence of moves.
text.zh: 有一个空步序列。

text.en: Zero and one are the same number.
text.zh: 零和一是同一个数。

text.en: Every DP must start with one.
text.zh: 所有 DP 都必须从一开始。

hints.en: Count routes that use no moves.
hints.zh: 数一数不做任何移动的走法。

explanation.en: The empty route is a single valid way to be at the start; the value follows from the state definition.
explanation.zh: 空走法是一种停在起点的合法方式；这个值来自状态定义。

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: Use remainders while keeping the algebraic conditions explicit.
summary.zh: 使用余数，同时保留代数条件。

objectives.en: Normalize a remainder and explain why modular division is special.
objectives.zh: 规范化余数，解释模意义下除法的特殊性。

objectives.en: Reduce sums and products modulo a positive modulus while respecting the integer type range.
objectives.zh: 对正模数下的和与积取模，并检查整数类型范围。

body.en: For a positive integer m, a and b are congruent modulo m when m divides a−b. This means their difference is a whole multiple of m. For example, 17 and 5 are congruent modulo 12. A canonical representative can be chosen from 0 through m−1.
body.zh: 对正整数 m，如果 m 整除 a−b，就称 a 与 b 模 m 同余，即二者之差是 m 的整数倍。例如 17 与 5 模 12 同余。可以从 0 到 m−1 选择标准代表元。

body.en: Replacing a value by a congruent one preserves the final remainder of sums and products. Therefore intermediate results can often be reduced modulo m. This does not automatically prevent overflow: the product must first be representable, or a safe multiplication method must be used.
body.zh: 把数替换为与它同余的数，不会改变和或积的最终余数，因此常可在中间步骤取模。但这不自动防止溢出：乘积仍必须先能被表示，或者使用安全的乘法方法。

body.en: The mathematical representative of −1 modulo 5 is 4. C++ remainder follows its integer-division rule and gives −1 % 5 equal to −1. With m positive, r = a % m; if (r < 0) r += m; produces a value in [0,m). This conditional form avoids an unnecessary addition for already nonnegative remainders.
body.zh: −1 模 5 的数学标准代表元是 4。C++ 的余数遵循整数除法规则，−1 % 5 得到 −1。m 为正时，先算 r = a % m;，若 r < 0 再加 m，就得到 [0,m) 中的值。这个写法不会给已经非负的余数做不必要的加法。

body.en: To divide by a modulo m, one needs a multiplicative inverse: a value u with au congruent to 1. Such an inverse exists exactly when gcd(a,m)=1. For example, 2 has no inverse modulo 6 because every 2u is even and cannot differ from 1 by a multiple of 6. Never replace division by an inverse without checking the condition.
body.zh: 模 m 除以 a，需要乘法逆元，即使 au 模 m 同余于 1 的 u。逆元存在的充要条件是 gcd(a,m)=1。例如 2 在模 6 下没有逆元，因为 2u 总为偶数，不可能与 1 相差 6 的倍数。不能不检查条件就把除法换成逆元。

prompt.en: What is the representative of −3 modulo 7 in [0,7)?
prompt.zh: −3 模 7 在 [0,7) 中的标准代表元是多少？

hints.en: Add one multiple of 7.
hints.zh: 加上一个 7 的倍数。

prompt.en: Which number in {0,1,2,3,4} is the inverse of 2 modulo 5?

hints.en: Find u such that 2u leaves remainder 1 after division by 5.
hints.zh: 寻找使 2u 除以 5 余 1 的 u。

explanation.en: 2 × 3 = 6 ≡ 1 (mod 5), so 3 is the inverse.

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines — language and program correctness reference
MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020

summary.en: A whole number counts objects. In base ten, each place is ten times the place to its right. A fraction a/b means a copies of one b-th of a whole, with b nonzero. A ratio compares two quantities in a stated order.
summary.zh: 整数用来计数；十进制中，每一位的值是右边一位的十倍。分数 a/b 表示 a 个“整体的 b 分之一”，b 不能为零。比按照指定顺序比较两个量。

objectives.en: Explain place value and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释位值及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use equivalent fractions in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用等值分数。

body.en: A whole number counts objects. In base ten, each place is ten times the place to its right. A fraction a/b means a copies of one b-th of a whole, with b nonzero. A ratio compares two quantities in a stated order.
body.zh: 整数用来计数；十进制中，每一位的值是右边一位的十倍。分数 a/b 表示 a 个“整体的 b 分之一”，b 不能为零。比按照指定顺序比较两个量。

body.en: A fraction represents division as well as equal parts: three wholes shared equally among four people gives each person 3/4. To compare fractions, rewrite them using the same whole and denominator; 2/3=8/12 exceeds 3/4=9/12 only if the inequality is reversed, so actually 2/3<3/4. Multiplication by a fraction scales a quantity: half of six is three. Dividing by a fraction asks how many such portions fit: six divided by one half is twelve. Before computing a ratio, convert quantities to compatible units; 50 cm to 2 m is 50:200=1:4.
body.zh: 分数也表示除法：三个整体平均分给四人，每人3/4。比较分数须同整体通分，2/3=8/12而3/4=9/12，所以2/3较小。乘分数表示缩放，六的一半为三；除分数问能装几份，六除一半为十二。列比前要统一单位，50厘米比2米为50:200=1:4。

body.en: To add 1/2 and 1/3, split the whole into sixths: 1/2 = 3/6 and 1/3 = 2/6, so the sum is 5/6. If three notebooks cost 12 yuan, the unit price is 12/3 = 4 yuan per notebook. Five such notebooks therefore cost 20 yuan.
body.zh: 计算 1/2 + 1/3 时，把整体分成六份：分别为 3/6 和 2/6，和为 5/6。三本笔记本共 12 元，每本价格为 12÷3=4 元；五本就是 20 元。

body.en: Do not add denominators: 1/2 + 1/2 is one whole, not 2/4. A ratio depends on order: distance/time is speed, while time/distance is not speed. Always name the whole for a fraction; half of a large cake need not equal half of a small cake.
body.zh: 不能把分母直接相加：两个二分之一合成一整个，而不是四分之二。距离除以时间是速度，反过来不是。分数必须说明所指整体，大蛋糕的一半不一定等于小蛋糕的一半。

prompt.en: What is 3/4 + 1/8?

hints.en: A whole number counts objects. In base ten, each place is ten times the place to its right. A fraction a/b means a copies of one b-th of a whole, with b nonzero. A ratio compares two quantities in a stated order.
hints.zh: 整数用来计数；十进制中，每一位的值是右边一位的十倍。分数 a/b 表示 a 个“整体的 b 分之一”，b 不能为零。比按照指定顺序比较两个量。

explanation.en: 3/4 = 6/8, so the sum is 7/8.

prompt.en: A ribbon is 3 metres long. How many pieces of length 3/8 metre fit exactly?
prompt.zh: 3米丝带恰好可分几段3/8米？

hints.en: Ask how many copies of 3/8 add to 3.
hints.zh: 问几个3/8相加得到3。

explanation.en: 3 divided by 3/8 equals 3×8/3=8; multiplying 8 by 3/8 checks the full length.

coverageNote.en: Core module lesson; further proof problems, transfer practice, and independent subject review remain part of curriculum development.
coverageNote.zh: 本课讲授模块核心内容；拓展证明、迁移练习与独立学科审校仍需继续完善。

summary.en: A variable is a symbol whose value can vary or is temporarily unknown. An expression describes a value; an equation asserts that two expressions have equal values. In 3x + 2, x is a variable, 3 its coefficient, and 2 a constant term.
summary.zh: 变量是值可以变化或暂时未知的符号。表达式表示数值；等式断言两个表达式的值相等。3x+2中，x是变量，3是系数，2是常数项。

objectives.en: Explain variable and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释变量及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use expression in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用表达式。

body.en: A variable is a symbol whose value can vary or is temporarily unknown. An expression describes a value; an equation asserts that two expressions have equal values. In 3x + 2, x is a variable, 3 its coefficient, and 2 a constant term.
body.zh: 变量是值可以变化或暂时未知的符号。表达式表示数值；等式断言两个表达式的值相等。3x+2中，x是变量，3是系数，2是常数项。

body.en: An expression can be viewed as a sequence of operations on an input. In 2(x+3), first add three and then double; in 2x+3, double first and then add three. Their outputs differ because grouping changes the calculation. To combine like terms, interpret coefficients as counts of the same object: three x quantities plus two x quantities make five x quantities. Powers create different objects, so x+x² cannot be reduced to 2x³. Substitution should preserve brackets around negative numbers and compound expressions. Checking two forms at one input may reveal a mistake, but only algebra establishes an identity for every input.
body.zh: 表达式可看成对输入施行操作：2(x+3)先加三再翻倍，2x+3先翻倍再加三，分组改变计算。同类项系数像同类对象的个数，三个x加两个x是五个x；x²是不同对象，不能把x+x²化成2x³。代入负数或复合式要保留括号。单点验算能发现错误，却只有代数论证能证明对所有输入恒等。

body.en: If x=4, then 2(x+3)=2×7=14. Expanding first gives 2x+6=8+6=14, the same result. To simplify 3x+2x+5, combine coefficients of the same variable: (3+2)x+5=5x+5.

An equals sign is a claim of equality, not an instruction meaning “and then.” The terms x and x² are not like terms. Write parentheses around negative substitutions: x² at x=−3 is (−3)²=9, whereas −3² conventionally means −9.
body.zh: 等号表示相等，不表示“然后”。x与x²不是同类项。代入负数应加括号：x=−3时，x²=(−3)²=9，而−3²通常表示−9。

prompt.en: Evaluate 4x−1 at x=3.
prompt.zh: x=3时，4x−1等于多少？

hints.en: A variable is a symbol whose value can vary or is temporarily unknown. An expression describes a value; an equation asserts that two expressions have equal values. In 3x + 2, x is a variable, 3 its coefficient, and 2 a constant term.
hints.zh: 变量是值可以变化或暂时未知的符号。表达式表示数值；等式断言两个表达式的值相等。3x+2中，x是变量，3是系数，2是常数项。

prompt.en: Evaluate 3(a−2)−a when a=−1.

hints.en: Replace both occurrences with (−1), keeping the subtraction sign.
hints.zh: 两处都代入(−1)，保留减号。

summary.en: A set is a collection with definite membership; order and repetition do not matter. A function f:A→B assigns exactly one element of B to each element of A. A is its domain, B its codomain, and the attained outputs form its image.
summary.zh: 集合是成员资格明确的对象集，顺序与重复不影响集合。函数f:A→B为A中每个元素指定B中唯一一个元素。A是定义域，B是陪域，实际取得的输出构成像集。

objectives.en: Explain membership and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释属于关系及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use domain and codomain in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用定义域与陪域。

body.en: A set is a collection with definite membership; order and repetition do not matter. A function f:A→B assigns exactly one element of B to each element of A. A is its domain, B its codomain, and the attained outputs form its image.
body.zh: 集合是成员资格明确的对象集，顺序与重复不影响集合。函数f:A→B为A中每个元素指定B中唯一一个元素。A是定义域，B是陪域，实际取得的输出构成像集。

body.en: The domain answers which inputs are allowed; the codomain answers which outputs are declared possible; the image records which are actually achieved. These sets can differ. For x↦x² from the reals to the reals, negative outputs are never reached and opposite nonzero inputs collide. Restricting the domain to nonnegative reals removes the collision, but surjectivity still requires restricting the codomain to nonnegative reals. This produces a bijection with inverse square root. To test whether a relation is a function, examine each allowed input separately: exactly one assigned output is required, even if other inputs share it.
body.zh: 定义域说明允许输入，陪域说明声明的输出范围，像集记录实际达到的输出。实数到实数的平方映射既到不了负数，也把相反数合并。将定义域限为非负去掉碰撞，还需把陪域限为非负才能满射，得到以平方根为逆的双射。检验函数应逐个看每个允许输入，必须恰有一个输出，但不同输入可共享输出。

body.en: For A={−1,0,1} and f(x)=x² into B={0,1,2}, the image is {0,1}. The preimage of 1 is {−1,1}. Thus f is neither injective nor surjective: two inputs collide, and 2 is missed.
body.zh: A={−1,0,1}，f(x)=x²，陪域B={0,1,2}时，像集是{0,1}，1的原像是{−1,1}。它既非单射也非满射：输入有碰撞，且2未被取到。

body.en: A formula alone does not always define a function on the proposed domain: 1/x has no real value at zero. An inverse function exists on the full codomain only for a bijection. Several inputs sharing one output is allowed; one input having several outputs is not.
body.zh: 只给公式未必能在指定定义域上定义函数：1/x在零处没有实数值。只有双射才有定义在整个陪域上的反函数。多个输入对应同一输出允许，一个输入对应多个输出则不允许。

prompt.en: How many elements are in {1,1,2,3}?
prompt.zh: 集合{1,1,2,3}有几个元素？

hints.en: A set is a collection with definite membership; order and repetition do not matter. A function f:A→B assigns exactly one element of B to each element of A. A is its domain, B its codomain, and the attained outputs form its image.
hints.zh: 集合是成员资格明确的对象集，顺序与重复不影响集合。函数f:A→B为A中每个元素指定B中唯一一个元素。A是定义域，B是陪域，实际取得的输出构成像集。

explanation.en: The set is {1,2,3}, with three elements.
explanation.zh: 该集合就是{1,2,3}，共三个元素。

prompt.en: For f:{−2,−1,0,1,2}→R given by f(x)=x², how many distinct outputs occur?
prompt.zh: f:{−2,−1,0,1,2}→R，f(x)=x²，实际有几个不同输出？

hints.en: Compute the set of squares and remove repetitions.
hints.zh: 计算平方集合，删除重复项。

explanation.en: The outputs are 4,1,0,1,4, whose distinct values are {0,1,4}: three outputs.

summary.en: A proposition has a truth value. “For every x” is universal, written ∀x; “there exists x” is existential, written ∃x. The implication P⇒Q fails exactly when P is true and Q is false. It does not claim that Q causes P.
summary.zh: 命题具有真假值。“对每个x”记为∀x，是全称量词；“存在x”记为∃x，是存在量词。P⇒Q仅在P真而Q假时为假，也不说明Q导致P。

objectives.en: Explain implication and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释蕴含及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use universal quantifier in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用全称量词。

body.en: A proposition has a truth value. “For every x” is universal, written ∀x; “there exists x” is existential, written ∃x. The implication P⇒Q fails exactly when P is true and Q is false. It does not claim that Q causes P.
body.zh: 命题具有真假值。“对每个x”记为∀x，是全称量词；“存在x”记为∃x，是存在量词。P⇒Q仅在P真而Q假时为假，也不说明Q导致P。

body.en: A quantified statement is like a challenge with an order of play. In ∀x∃y, an opponent chooses x first and you may respond with a suitable y. In ∃y∀x, you must commit to one y before seeing every possible x. This explains why the two formulas can differ. Negating an implication P⇒Q produces P and not Q: a genuine counterexample must satisfy the hypothesis and violate the conclusion. De Morgan rules negate “and” to “or” and vice versa. Over a specified domain, the negation of “every x has P(x)” is “some x lacks P(x),” including the correct equality boundary for inequalities.
body.zh: 量词可看成按顺序进行的挑战：∀x∃y允许先看x再选y；∃y∀x则须预先固定一个y应对所有x。因此顺序能改变真假。P⇒Q的否定为P且非Q，反例必须满足假设却不满足结论。德摩根法则把且与或互换；否定“所有x有P”是“存在x没有P”，不等式还要正确处理等号边界。

body.en: Over the integers, ∀x∃y(y>x) is true: choose y=x+1. In contrast, ∃y∀x(y>x) is false because x=y already contradicts the condition. The same symbols in a different order express a different mathematical claim.
body.zh: 在整数中，∀x∃y(y>x)为真，可取y=x+1。∃y∀x(y>x)则为假，因为取x=y就矛盾。符号顺序不同，数学断言也不同。

body.en: The converse Q⇒P need not follow from P⇒Q. “Divisible by four implies even” is true, but two is a counterexample to the converse. When negating an inequality, include equality correctly: the negation of x>3 is x≤3.
body.zh: P⇒Q不能推出逆命题Q⇒P。“被4整除则为偶数”正确，但2反驳其逆命题。否定不等式要正确处理等号：x>3的否定为x≤3。

prompt.en: Among integers 1 through 6, how many disprove “every integer here is even”?
prompt.zh: 整数1到6中，有几个反驳“这里每个整数都是偶数”？

hints.en: A proposition has a truth value. “For every x” is universal, written ∀x; “there exists x” is existential, written ∃x. The implication P⇒Q fails exactly when P is true and Q is false. It does not claim that Q causes P.
hints.zh: 命题具有真假值。“对每个x”记为∀x，是全称量词；“存在x”记为∃x，是存在量词。P⇒Q仅在P真而Q假时为假，也不说明Q导致P。

explanation.en: 1,3,5 each make the predicate false.
explanation.zh: 1、3、5都使条件为假。

prompt.en: Among integers 1 through 8, how many counterexamples refute “if n is even then n is divisible by 4”?
prompt.zh: 整数1至8中，有几个反例反驳“若n偶则n被4整除”？

hints.en: Only even numbers can satisfy the hypothesis; remove multiples of four.
hints.zh: 只看满足假设的偶数，再排除4的倍数。

explanation.en: The even numbers are 2,4,6,8. Exactly 2 and 6 violate the conclusion, so there are two counterexamples.
explanation.zh: 偶数2、4、6、8中，恰2与6不满足结论，共两个反例。

summary.en: A graph assigns position to data using named axes and units. A linear axis uses equal distances for equal differences. A logarithmic axis uses equal distances for equal ratios. An estimate is a deliberately approximate value whose useful precision matches the information available.
summary.zh: 图像借助带名称与单位的坐标轴把数据变成位置。线性轴以等距表示等差，对数轴以等距表示等比。估算是有意采用的近似，其精度应与已知信息匹配。

objectives.en: Explain axis scale and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释坐标轴尺度及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use order of magnitude in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用数量级。

body.en: A graph assigns position to data using named axes and units. A linear axis uses equal distances for equal differences. A logarithmic axis uses equal distances for equal ratios. An estimate is a deliberately approximate value whose useful precision matches the information available.
body.zh: 图像借助带名称与单位的坐标轴把数据变成位置。线性轴以等距表示等差，对数轴以等距表示等比。估算是有意采用的近似，其精度应与已知信息匹配。

body.en: A graph makes a claim through both the data positions and the chosen scales. On a linear axis from zero to one hundred, equal pixel gaps represent equal numerical differences. On a logarithmic axis, equal gaps represent equal multiplication factors, so ten to one hundred occupies the same gap as one hundred to one thousand. For a line graph, compute slope from actual coordinate changes, not the apparent angle on the screen. Estimate first by rounding while keeping the scale of the result. Then ask whether the approximation is above or below the original quantity; this helps detect errors before detailed arithmetic.
body.zh: 图像同时由点的位置和尺度作出断言。线性轴等距代表等差；对数轴等距代表等倍，所以10到100与100到1000等距。斜率须用实际坐标差，不能靠屏幕倾角判断。先取整保留数量级，再判断估值偏大还是偏小，这能在详细计算前帮助发现错误。

body.en: A journey graph contains (2 h,120 km) and (5 h,300 km). The average rate between them is (300−120)/(5−2)=60 km/h. Estimating 198×51 as 200×50 gives about 10000, a quick scale check before exact multiplication gives 10098.
body.zh: 行程图含(2小时,120千米)与(5小时,300千米)，区间平均速度为180÷3=60千米/时。198×51可估为200×50≈10000，再与精确值10098核对数量级。

body.en: A truncated vertical axis can visually exaggerate a difference. A straight line on logarithmic axes need not represent a linear relationship in the original quantities. Do not infer unmeasured fine detail from a coarse graph or report more significant digits than the input supports.
body.zh: 截断纵轴会夸大视觉差异。对数坐标上的直线未必对应原量之间的线性关系。粗略图像不能支持未测量的细节，也不能支持超过输入精度的有效数字。

prompt.en: A quantity rises from 8 to 20 in 4 seconds. What is its average rate?
prompt.zh: 某量在4秒内从8增至20，平均变化率是多少？

hints.en: A graph assigns position to data using named axes and units. A linear axis uses equal distances for equal differences. A logarithmic axis uses equal distances for equal ratios. An estimate is a deliberately approximate value whose useful precision matches the information available.
hints.zh: 图像借助带名称与单位的坐标轴把数据变成位置。线性轴以等距表示等差，对数轴以等距表示等比。估算是有意采用的近似，其精度应与已知信息匹配。

explanation.en: (20−8)/4=3 per second.

prompt.en: A line passes through (2 hours,14 km) and (5 hours,35 km). What is its slope in km/h?
prompt.zh: 直线过(2小时,14千米)、(5小时,35千米)，斜率多少千米/时？

hints.en: Divide the difference in distance by the difference in time.
hints.zh: 距离差除时间差。

explanation.en: (35−14)/(5−2)=21/3=7 km/h; using 35/5 happens to agree here but is not the general two-point rule.

summary.en: A mathematical explanation names its objects, states assumptions, connects justified steps, and identifies the conclusion. Symbols compress meaning only after their meaning is defined. An equation chain asserts that every listed expression has the same value.
summary.zh: 数学说明要命名对象、写明假设、连接有依据的步骤并指出结论。符号只有定义后才能有效压缩意义；连等式断言其中每个表达式都相等。

objectives.en: Explain defined symbols and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释符号定义及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use equivalent transformations in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用等价变形。

body.en: A mathematical explanation names its objects, states assumptions, connects justified steps, and identifies the conclusion. Symbols compress meaning only after their meaning is defined. An equation chain asserts that every listed expression has the same value.
body.zh: 数学说明要命名对象、写明假设、连接有依据的步骤并指出结论。符号只有定义后才能有效压缩意义；连等式断言其中每个表达式都相等。

body.en: A reader should be able to tell which quantities were given, which were introduced, and which were proved. Use “let” to introduce a symbol, but do not choose it in a way that already assumes the desired conclusion. Separate equalities from implications: squaring two equal real numbers preserves equality, while the reverse inference introduces a sign choice. When reporting a solution, state the set of all allowed answers rather than one convenient answer. For an approximation, show the rounding precision. Finally, substitute candidate values into the original problem, because a sequence of algebraic manipulations may have hidden a forbidden denominator or lost a case.
body.zh: 读者应能区分已知、引入和已证的量。用“设”定义符号时，不能暗中假设结论。等号与蕴含须分清：相等实数平方后仍相等，反推则多了符号选择。解题应报告全部允许答案，不是只报方便的一个；近似应说明精度。最后代回原题，因为变形可能隐藏分母限制或丢掉分支。

body.en: Solve (x²−1)/(x−1)=3 over the reals. First exclude x=1. Factor the numerator as (x−1)(x+1), cancel only because x≠1, then obtain x+1=3 and x=2. Substituting into the original expression gives 3, confirming the admissible solution.
body.zh: 解(x²−1)/(x−1)=3时，先排除x=1。分解分子为(x−1)(x+1)，因x≠1才能约去，得到x+1=3，即x=2。代回原式等于3，确认解合法。

body.en: Do not hide a missing argument behind “obviously.” A diagram suggests relationships but does not prove exact equality unless the assumptions guarantee it. Use = for equality, ≈ for approximation, and ⇒ for a logical consequence; these symbols have different jobs.
body.zh: 不要用“显然”掩盖缺失论证。图形能提示关系，却不能单独证明精确相等。等号表示相等，≈表示近似，⇒表示逻辑推出，三者作用不同。

prompt.en: Solve (x²−4)/(x−2)=7, with x≠2.

hints.en: A mathematical explanation names its objects, states assumptions, connects justified steps, and identifies the conclusion. Symbols compress meaning only after their meaning is defined. An equation chain asserts that every listed expression has the same value.
hints.zh: 数学说明要命名对象、写明假设、连接有依据的步骤并指出结论。符号只有定义后才能有效压缩意义；连等式断言其中每个表达式都相等。

explanation.en: Cancel x−2 to get x+2=7, so x=5; it is allowed.
explanation.zh: 约去x−2得x+2=7，故x=5，且满足限制。

prompt.en: Solve (x²−9)/(x−3)=8 with its original domain restriction. What is x?
prompt.zh: 按原定义域解(x²−9)/(x−3)=8，x多少？

hints.en: Exclude x=3, factor the numerator, then solve the remaining linear equation.
hints.zh: 先排除3，再分解分子并解一次方程。

explanation.en: For x≠3 the expression is x+3. Thus x=5, and 5 is permitted; substitution gives (25−9)/2=8.

summary.en: A definition fixes meaning; a theorem needs proof. One counterexample disproves a universal claim, provided it satisfies every hypothesis.
summary.zh: 定义规定意义，定理需要证明。反例必须满足全部假设；一个合格反例就能推翻全称命题。

objectives.en: Explain definition and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释定义及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use universal claim in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用全称命题。

body.en: A definition fixes meaning; a theorem needs proof. One counterexample disproves a universal claim, provided it satisfies every hypothesis.
body.zh: 定义规定意义，定理需要证明。反例必须满足全部假设；一个合格反例就能推翻全称命题。

body.en: A definition provides a membership test. For example, an integer n is even exactly when n=2k for some integer k; one cannot declare an unfamiliar number even merely because it looks large or ends in a familiar symbol. A universal claim then makes a promise about every object passing a hypothesis test. To refute it, keep the hypothesis true and make the conclusion false. To repair it, consider whether a missing condition removes every counterexample, then prove the restricted statement. Testing finitely many cases is valuable for discovery but leaves infinitely many unchecked cases when the domain is infinite.
body.zh: 定义提供成员检验，如偶数恰能写成2k且k为整数，不能凭外观判断。全称命题对每个满足假设的对象承诺结论。反驳须保持假设真并令结论假。修复要判断新增条件是否排除全部反例，再证明受限命题。有限检验有助发现，却无法覆盖无限定义域中所有未检情况。

body.en: “Every prime is odd” fails at 2: it has exactly two positive divisors, 1 and 2, yet is even. The corrected statement excludes this case.
body.zh: “每个素数都是奇数”在2处失败：2恰有正因数1和2，却是偶数。修正命题须排除这个情况。

body.en: An example outside the assumptions is irrelevant. A definition is not proved by listing examples.
body.zh: 不满足假设的例子无关；列举例子也不能证明一个定义。

prompt.en: What is the smallest even prime?
prompt.zh: 最小的偶素数是多少？

hints.en: A definition fixes meaning; a theorem needs proof. One counterexample disproves a universal claim, provided it satisfies every hypothesis.
hints.zh: 定义规定意义，定理需要证明。反例必须满足全部假设；一个合格反例就能推翻全称命题。

explanation.en: Only 2 is both prime and even.
explanation.zh: 只有2既是素数又是偶数。

prompt.en: How many of 2,3,4,5 are counterexamples to “every prime exceeds 3”?
prompt.zh: 2、3、4、5中有几个反例反驳“每个素数都大于3”？

hints.en: A counterexample must first be prime, then fail to exceed 3.
hints.zh: 反例首先必须是素数，然后不大于3。

explanation.en: 2 and 3 are prime but not greater than 3. The number 4 fails the premise, and 5 satisfies the conclusion.
explanation.zh: 2和3为素数却不大于3；4不满足前提，5满足结论。

summary.en: To prove P⇒Q, assume P and derive Q. To prove P⇔Q, establish both implications; one direction is insufficient.
summary.zh: 证明P⇒Q要假设P并推出Q；证明P⇔Q必须完成两个方向。

objectives.en: Explain direct proof and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释直接证明及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use biconditional in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用充要条件。

body.en: To prove P⇒Q, assume P and derive Q. To prove P⇔Q, establish both implications; one direction is insufficient.
body.zh: 证明P⇒Q要假设P并推出Q；证明P⇔Q必须完成两个方向。

body.en: A direct proof starts with an arbitrary object satisfying the hypotheses. “Arbitrary” means no extra convenient property may be assumed. Translate each hypothesis into its defining form, then use algebra or an already justified theorem. For parity, two odd integers have forms 2r+1 and 2s+1, so their product is 2(2rs+r+s)+1 and is odd. The integer inside the parentheses supplies the witness required by the definition. An equivalence requires repeating the argument in the opposite direction or using transformations known to be reversible. A one-way implication should never be silently relabeled as an equivalence.
body.zh: 直接证明从任意满足假设的对象开始，不能再附加方便条件。把假设写成定义形式，例如奇数2r+1、2s+1的积为2(2rs+r+s)+1，括号中整数正是定义所需见证。等价证明还需反方向，或证明所有变形可逆；单向蕴含不能默认为等价。

body.en: If a=2r and b=2s are even integers, a+b=2(r+s). Because r+s is an integer, their sum is even by definition.
body.zh: 若a=2r、b=2s是偶数，则a+b=2(r+s)。r+s为整数，因此和按定义为偶数。

body.en: P⇒Q is equivalent to not Q⇒not P. A contradiction proof assumes the hypotheses and the negation of the conclusion, then derives an impossibility.
body.zh: P⇒Q等价于非Q⇒非P。反证法在假设下再假设结论不成立，推出矛盾。

body.en: Contraposition is often effective when the negated conclusion has a simple description. To show a prime above two is odd, suppose instead that it is even: it equals 2k, and being above two forces k>1, producing a nontrivial factor. A contradiction proof permits assuming the desired statement false, but every later step must follow from that temporary assumption plus the original hypotheses. The resulting contradiction may be an impossible equality, a violated hypothesis, or two opposite inequalities. At the end, explicitly discharge the temporary assumption. Never confuse “I found no example” with a logical contradiction.
body.zh: 当否定结论易描述时逆否有效。欲证大于2的素数为奇，若其偶则写2k；大于2迫使k>1，产生非平凡因子。反证可暂设结论不成立，但后续每步必须从临时假设与原假设推出。矛盾可以是非法等式、违背假设或相反不等关系；结尾要撤销临时假设。没找到例子不等于逻辑矛盾。

body.en: To show n² odd implies n odd, prove the contrapositive: if n=2k, then n²=4k²=2(2k²) is even. This handles every even integer at once.
body.zh: 证明n²为奇数则n为奇数，可证逆否：若n=2k，则n²=4k²=2(2k²)为偶数，一次覆盖所有偶整数。

body.en: The converse and contrapositive differ. A contradiction must follow from valid steps, not from dividing by zero or making an unrelated false assertion.
body.zh: 逆命题不同于逆否命题；矛盾必须由合法步骤推出，不能靠除零或无关的错误断言。

summary.zh: 归纳法证明整数编号的命题：先证起点，再证当前成立能够推出下一项。强归纳法可使用所有之前的情况。

body.en: Induction proves a statement indexed by integers: establish the first case, then show each valid case implies the next. Strong induction may use all preceding cases.
body.zh: 归纳法证明整数编号的命题：先证起点，再证当前成立能够推出下一项。强归纳法可使用所有之前的情况。

body.en: The logical force of induction is that a valid starting case can travel along every finite chain of successor steps. In the inductive step, assume only the claim at a generic index k, then derive the claim at k+1 using the exact algebra of that index. For a recurrence involving two earlier terms, strong induction or two initial cases may be needed. To prove 2^n≥n+1 for n≥0, start at n=0. If 2^k≥k+1, then 2^(k+1)≥2k+2≥k+2 because k≥0. The last inequality is a separate necessary justification.
body.zh: 归纳的力量在于起点可沿任意有限后继链传递。归纳步只能暂假一般k时结论，再准确推出k+1。涉及前两项的递推可能需要强归纳或两个初值。证明2^n≥n+1，n=0成立；若k成立，则2^(k+1)≥2k+2≥k+2，最后一步用k≥0，不能省略理由。

body.en: For 1+…+n=n(n+1)/2, the case n=1 holds. Assuming the formula at k, add k+1: k(k+1)/2+(k+1)=(k+1)(k+2)/2.
The induction hypothesis is a temporary assumption, not the theorem for all indices. A step without a base case proves no starting instance.
body.zh: 归纳假设只是临时假设，不是全部命题已成立；没有起点的归纳步骤不能保证任何实例。

summary.en: An invariant stays unchanged under every legal move. A monovariant changes in only one direction. An extremal argument selects a smallest or largest object to restrict what can happen.
summary.zh: 不变量在每次合法操作下保持不变；单调量只朝一个方向变化；极值论证选择最小或最大对象来限制可能情况。

objectives.en: Explain invariant and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释不变量及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use monovariant in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用单调量。

body.en: An invariant stays unchanged under every legal move. A monovariant changes in only one direction. An extremal argument selects a smallest or largest object to restrict what can happen.
body.zh: 不变量在每次合法操作下保持不变；单调量只朝一个方向变化；极值论证选择最小或最大对象来限制可能情况。

body.en: To find an invariant, first write down exactly how a legal move changes the state. If a move adds two to one coordinate and subtracts two from another, both the total sum and each coordinate’s parity remain unchanged. A target violating either property is unreachable. The converse need not hold: preserving known invariants does not prove a path exists. A monovariant supports termination only with a lower or upper bound preventing endless change; a strictly decreasing positive real sequence can continue forever, while a nonnegative integer dropping by at least one cannot. Extremal arguments exploit the contradiction between minimal choice and a constructed smaller object.
body.zh: 寻找不变量先写每步如何改变状态。某坐标加二、另一坐标减二时，总和与各坐标奇偶性都不变，违反任一性质的目标不可达。但满足已知不变量不保证有路径。单调量证终止还需界：正实数严格下降仍可无限，非负整数每步至少减一则不能。极值法利用“最小对象”与构造出的更小对象冲突。

body.en: Changing an integer by +2 or −2 preserves its parity. Starting at 3 therefore never reaches 10. The invariant is the remainder modulo 2, not the magnitude.
body.zh: 每次加2或减2保持奇偶性，因此从3不可能到10。不变量是模2余数，而不是数的大小。

body.en: An invariant must be checked for every allowed operation. Being unable to find a path does not itself prove impossibility.
body.zh: 必须对每一种允许操作检查不变量；没找到路径本身并不证明不可能。

prompt.en: Starting at 7 and repeatedly adding 4, what is the remainder modulo 4?
prompt.zh: 从7开始反复加4，模4余数是多少？

hints.en: An invariant stays unchanged under every legal move. A monovariant changes in only one direction. An extremal argument selects a smallest or largest object to restrict what can happen.
hints.zh: 不变量在每次合法操作下保持不变；单调量只朝一个方向变化；极值论证选择最小或最大对象来限制可能情况。

explanation.en: Adding 4 preserves the initial remainder 3.
explanation.zh: 加4保持初始余数3。

prompt.en: Starting at 11, each move adds or subtracts 6. Can 20 be reached? Enter 1 yes, 0 no.
prompt.zh: 从11开始每步加减6，能到20吗？能1不能0。

hints.en: Compare the remainders modulo 6.
hints.zh: 比较模6余数。

explanation.en: 11≡5 and 20≡2 modulo 6. Every allowed move preserves the remainder, so reaching 20 is impossible.
explanation.zh: 11模6余5，20余2，每步保持余数，因此不可达。

summary.en: A proof audit checks definitions, quantifiers, domains, and each implication separately. State what is being proved before introducing auxiliary objects.
summary.zh: 检查证明要分别核对定义、量词、定义域和每个蕴含；引入辅助对象之前先说明目标。

body.en: A proof audit checks definitions, quantifiers, domains, and each implication separately. State what is being proved before introducing auxiliary objects.
body.zh: 检查证明要分别核对定义、量词、定义域和每个蕴含；引入辅助对象之前先说明目标。

body.en: Audit a proof in three passes. First check the statement: are all variables quantified, all domains given, and all special cases included? Next inspect each transition: is it an implication, an equivalence, a definition, or an application of a theorem whose assumptions are met? Finally examine the conclusion: has existence been shown, have all solutions been captured, and are equality or boundary cases handled? For x(x−2)=0, splitting into x=0 or x=2 is exhaustive by the zero-product property over the reals. In a ring with zero divisors that inference is unavailable, illustrating why the ambient setting is part of a proof.
body.zh: 证明检查可分三轮：先核命题的量词、定义域与特殊情况；再逐步辨明蕴含、等价、定义或定理应用，并查条件；最后核结论是否证明存在、覆盖全部解并处理边界。实数上x(x−2)=0分成0或2由零乘积性质保证穷尽，但有零因子的环中不能这样推，说明环境也是证明的一部分。

body.en: The argument x²=x, divide by x, hence x=1 loses x=0. Repair it by factoring x(x−1)=0 and using the zero-product property, obtaining both 0 and 1.
body.zh: x²=x直接除以x得到x=1会漏掉x=0。修复方法是分解为x(x−1)=0，利用零乘积性质得到0与1。

body.en: A correct final answer cannot repair an invalid inference. For numerical evidence, distinguish an observed pattern from a universally established result.
body.zh: 正确答案不能修复非法推理；数值证据中，要区分观察到的规律与已证明的普遍结论。

prompt.en: How many real solutions satisfy x²=4x?
prompt.zh: x²=4x有几个实数解？

hints.en: A proof audit checks definitions, quantifiers, domains, and each implication separately. State what is being proved before introducing auxiliary objects.
hints.zh: 检查证明要分别核对定义、量词、定义域和每个蕴含；引入辅助对象之前先说明目标。

explanation.en: x(x−4)=0 gives 0 and 4.

hints.en: Factor first and identify the excluded divisor value.

explanation.en: x(x−7)=0 has solutions 0 and 7. Dividing by x excludes exactly the solution 0, losing one.
explanation.zh: x(x−7)=0解0与7，除x恰丢0这一个。

summary.en: A unit supplies a reference size; dimension records the kind of quantity. Speed has dimension length/time and SI unit metre per second.
summary.zh: 单位提供参照大小，量纲说明量的种类。速度的量纲是长度/时间，SI单位是米每秒。

objectives.en: Explain base unit and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释基本单位及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use derived unit in a worked solution.

body.en: A unit supplies a reference size; dimension records the kind of quantity. Speed has dimension length/time and SI unit metre per second.
body.zh: 单位提供参照大小，量纲说明量的种类。速度的量纲是长度/时间，SI单位是米每秒。

body.en: Dimensional analysis treats the dimensions of multiplication and division like algebraic factors. If distance has dimension L and time T, acceleration has dimension L/T². Thus mass times acceleration has dimension ML/T², defining force units. In a proposed equation, all added terms must share a dimension, including constants that may themselves carry units. Conversion factors should be written so unwanted units cancel. For area and volume, raise the entire conversion factor to the second or third power. This prevents the common mistake of converting square metres to square centimetres by only a factor of one hundred.
body.zh: 量纲分析把乘除中的量纲当代数因子，长度L、时间T给加速度L/T²，质量乘加速度为ML/T²，即力。相加项必须同量纲，常数也可能带单位。换算因子应让旧单位消去，面积体积须把整个因子平方或立方，防止平方米只乘100就当平方厘米。

body.en: Convert 72 km/h by multiplying 1000 m/km and dividing 3600 s/h: 72×1000/3600=20 m/s. Conversion factors equal one, so the physical quantity is unchanged.
body.zh: 72千米/时乘1000米/千米，再除3600秒/时，得到20米/秒。换算因子等于一，不改变物理量。

body.en: You may add only quantities of the same dimension. Dimensional consistency is necessary but cannot determine a missing numerical factor such as one half.
body.zh: 只有同量纲的量才能相加；量纲一致是必要条件，却不能确定二分之一之类的数值系数。

prompt.en: Convert 36 km/h to m/s.
prompt.zh: 36千米/时等于多少米/秒？

hints.en: A unit supplies a reference size; dimension records the kind of quantity. Speed has dimension length/time and SI unit metre per second.
hints.zh: 单位提供参照大小，量纲说明量的种类。速度的量纲是长度/时间，SI单位是米每秒。

hints.en: One metre is 100 cm, so cube 100 for volume.

summary.en: Resolution is the smallest distinguishable change. Random variation changes between trials; systematic error shifts results in a consistent way. Uncertainty describes a range of plausible values under stated assumptions.
summary.zh: 分辨率是可区分的最小变化；随机波动在试验间变化，系统误差一致地偏移结果。不确定度在明确假设下描述合理值范围。

objectives.en: Explain resolution and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释分辨率及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use random error in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用随机误差。

body.en: Resolution is the smallest distinguishable change. Random variation changes between trials; systematic error shifts results in a consistent way. Uncertainty describes a range of plausible values under stated assumptions.
body.zh: 分辨率是可区分的最小变化；随机波动在试验间变化，系统误差一致地偏移结果。不确定度在明确假设下描述合理值范围。

body.en: A measured value is the outcome of a procedure, not an exact view of nature. Resolution limits what changes can be distinguished; calibration compares the instrument against a reference. Repeatability concerns the spread of repeated readings under similar conditions, whereas accuracy concerns agreement with a reference value. An offset error can leave repeatability excellent while shifting every result. If only a stated bound ±δ is available, preserve that interpretation rather than silently treating it as a standard deviation. In independent random-error models, averaging can reduce uncertainty, but shared systematic error is not divided away by increasing the number of readings.
body.zh: 测量值是过程输出，不是对自然的精确读取。分辨率限制可区分变化，校准与参考比较。重复性看相似条件下读数散布，准确性看与参考吻合；偏置可让重复性很好却整体偏离。若只给±δ界，不可默当标准差。独立随机误差下平均可降低不确定度，但共同系统误差不会因增加次数而除掉。

body.en: Measurements 9.8,10.0,10.2 mm average to 10.0 mm. Their spread does not prove the ruler is calibrated. If every reading is 0.5 mm high, averaging preserves that bias.
body.zh: 9.8、10.0、10.2毫米的平均值为10.0毫米；离散程度不能证明尺子校准正确。若每次都高0.5毫米，平均仍保留偏差。

body.en: Do not confuse accuracy with repeatability. Writing extra decimal places does not improve an instrument. Specify whether a reported uncertainty is a bound or a statistical interval.
body.zh: 准确不等于重复性好；多写小数位不能改善仪器。应说明不确定度是界限还是统计区间。

prompt.en: Find the mean of 4.9,5.0,5.1.

hints.en: Resolution is the smallest distinguishable change. Random variation changes between trials; systematic error shifts results in a consistent way. Uncertainty describes a range of plausible values under stated assumptions.
hints.zh: 分辨率是可区分的最小变化；随机波动在试验间变化，系统误差一致地偏移结果。不确定度在明确假设下描述合理值范围。

explanation.en: Their sum is 15; divide by three.
explanation.zh: 和为15，除以3。

prompt.zh: 四次读数均已知偏高0.2克，均值8.7克，修正均值多少？

explanation.zh: 8.7−0.2=8.5克；不能只减0.2/4，因为每次都带相同偏置。

summary.zh: 散点图展示成对观察。趋势、离散与离群值描述不同特征。关联表示共同变化，不指定因果机制。

objectives.en: Use slope units in a worked solution.

body.en: A scatter plot shows paired observations. Trend, spread, and outliers describe different features. Association means quantities vary together; it does not specify a causal mechanism.
body.zh: 散点图展示成对观察。趋势、离散与离群值描述不同特征。关联表示共同变化，不指定因果机制。

body.en: A plotted point has two coordinates and both may have uncertainty. Start by identifying what was manipulated, what was measured, and which variable belongs on each axis. A linear trend suggests a constant rate, but residuals can reveal curvature that the main plot hides. An outlier is an observation far from the model or surrounding data, not automatically a mistake. Investigate whether it reflects a transcription problem, a changed condition, or genuine variation. Interpreting an average slope over a time interval does not imply the instantaneous rate stayed constant throughout it. A horizontal position graph means stationary, whereas a horizontal velocity graph means constant velocity.
body.zh: 点的两个坐标都可能有不确定度。先辨操控量、测量量与轴。直线趋势提示恒变化率，但残差可显露主图隐藏的弯曲。离群值是偏离模型或周围数据的观察，不自动是错误，应查抄录、条件变化或真实波动。区间平均斜率不意味瞬时率始终不变；水平位置图表示静止，水平速度图表示匀速。

body.en: For time 1,2,3 s and position 2,4,6 m, the points fit position=2×time. The slope is 2 m/s. A position of 9 m at 3 s would leave a residual of 3 m.
body.zh: 时间1、2、3秒对应位置2、4、6米，符合位置=2×时间，斜率为2米/秒。若3秒测得9米，残差为3米。

body.en: Join points only when interpolation is meaningful. Bar-chart categories do not necessarily form a continuous variable, and visual correlation does not remove confounding.
body.zh: 只有内插有意义时才连接点；柱状图类别未必连续，视觉相关也不能排除混杂因素。

prompt.en: Between (2 s,5 m) and (6 s,17 m), what is the slope in m/s?
prompt.zh: (2秒,5米)到(6秒,17米)的斜率是多少米/秒？

hints.en: A scatter plot shows paired observations. Trend, spread, and outliers describe different features. Association means quantities vary together; it does not specify a causal mechanism.
hints.zh: 散点图展示成对观察。趋势、离散与离群值描述不同特征。关联表示共同变化，不指定因果机制。

prompt.en: A position graph changes from 10 m at 2 s to 4 m at 5 s. What is average velocity in m/s?
prompt.zh: 位置从2秒10米变到5秒4米，平均速度多少米/秒？

hints.en: Use signed displacement, not total distance.
hints.zh: 使用有符号位移，不是总路程。

explanation.en: (4−10)/(5−2)=−6/3=−2 m/s. Negative means motion in the chosen negative coordinate direction overall.
explanation.zh: (4−10)/(5−2)=−2米/秒，负号表示整体朝所选坐标负方向。
