summary.en: Least squares minimizes ||Ax−b||². Its residual is orthogonal to the column space, giving AᵀAx=Aᵀb.
summary.zh: 最小二乘最小化||Ax−b||²；残差垂直列空间，因此AᵀAx=Aᵀb。

objectives.en: Explain normal equations and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释正规方程及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use residual in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用残差。

body.en: Least squares minimizes ||Ax−b||². Its residual is orthogonal to the column space, giving AᵀAx=Aᵀb.
body.zh: 最小二乘最小化||Ax−b||²；残差垂直列空间，因此AᵀAx=Aᵀb。

body.en:
An inconsistent system Ax=b has no exact solution, but it may have a useful approximate solution. Least squares chooses x to minimize the squared Euclidean length of the error Ax−b. Because Ax always lies in the column space of A, this asks for the point in that subspace nearest b. It is a geometric projection problem, not a rule saying that the original equations suddenly become consistent.

At the minimum, the residual r=b−Ax must be perpendicular to every column. Otherwise moving a little in a column direction would reduce the distance. Collecting those perpendicularity conditions gives Aᵀr=0, hence the normal equations AᵀAx=Aᵀb. If A has independent columns, AᵀA is positive definite and the minimizing coefficient vector is unique. With dependent columns, the projected point is still unique but several coefficient vectors may describe it.

Fitting a constant c to observations 2,4,9 uses a column of three ones. The normal equation is 3c=15, so c=5. The residuals −3,−1,4 sum to zero, expressing orthogonality to the constant column. A line fit instead uses columns of ones and input coordinates. Compare residual patterns afterward: a curved pattern can show that the chosen linear model misses structure. In numerical software, QR or SVD is often preferable to forming AᵀA because normal equations can amplify conditioning problems.
body.zh:
当 Ax=b 不相容时，没有精确解，但仍可能有有用的近似解。最小二乘选择 x，使误差 Ax−b 的欧氏长度平方最小。由于 Ax 一定位于 A 的列空间中，这实际上是在子空间内寻找距 b 最近的点，即正交投影，并没有使原来的矛盾方程变得相容。

最优点处，残差 r=b−Ax 必须垂直于每一列；否则沿某列方向稍微移动，就能进一步减小距离。把这些条件写在一起得到 Aᵀr=0，也就是正规方程 AᵀAx=Aᵀb。若 A 的列无关，则 AᵀA 正定，最优系数向量唯一。列相关时，投影点仍唯一，但可能有多个系数向量表示同一点。

用常数 c 拟合数据 2、4、9，对应由三个 1 组成的一列。正规方程为 3c=15，所以 c=5。残差 −3、−1、4 之和为零，正体现残差与常数列正交。拟合直线时再加入由输入坐标组成的一列。拟合后还要检查残差图样：弯曲趋势可能说明线性模型遗漏结构。数值计算通常优先采用 QR 或 SVD，因为直接形成 AᵀA 可能放大病态性。

body.en: Project b=(3,4) onto the x-axis: the closest point is (3,0), residual (0,4), squared error 16.
body.zh: 把(3,4)投影到x轴，最近点(3,0)，残差(0,4)，平方误差16。

body.en: Normal equations can worsen numerical conditioning; QR or SVD is often preferable computationally.
body.zh: 正规方程可能恶化数值条件，计算常优先QR或SVD。

prompt.en: Which constant minimizes (c−1)²+(c−5)²+(c−12)²?
prompt.zh: 哪个常数使 (c−1)²+(c−5)²+(c−12)² 最小？

hints.en: The normal equation makes the three residuals sum to zero.
hints.zh: 正规方程要求三个残差之和为零。

prompt.en: If A has dependent columns, which statement about least squares is guaranteed?
prompt.zh: 若 A 的列相关，关于最小二乘哪个结论一定成立？

text.en: The nearest point Ax in the column space is unique
text.zh: 列空间内最近的点 Ax 唯一

text.en: The coefficient vector x is unique
text.zh: 系数向量 x 唯一

text.en: The residual is always zero
text.zh: 残差总为零

hints.en: Different coefficient vectors can describe the same point.

summary.en: Every real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal eigenbasis and real eigenvalues: A=QΛQᵀ.
summary.zh: 实对称矩阵有正交归一特征基和实特征值，A=QΛQᵀ。

objectives.en: Explain symmetric matrix and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释对称矩阵及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use orthogonal eigenbasis in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用正交特征基。

body.en: Every real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal eigenbasis and real eigenvalues: A=QΛQᵀ.
body.zh: 实对称矩阵有正交归一特征基和实特征值，A=QΛQᵀ。

body.en:
A real symmetric matrix equals its transpose. The spectral theorem says that such a matrix has real eigenvalues and an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors. Thus A=QΛQᵀ, where Q is orthogonal and Λ is real diagonal. Orthogonal means QᵀQ=I, so changing to these coordinates preserves lengths and angles. This is stronger than ordinary diagonalizability, which may use a badly scaled nonorthogonal basis.

Why are different eigendirections perpendicular? If Au=λu and Av=μv, symmetry gives (Au)·v=u·(Av), so λ(u·v)=μ(u·v). When λ differs from μ, u·v must be zero. If an eigenvalue repeats, choose an orthonormal basis inside its eigenspace; every combination stays in that eigenspace, so orthogonalizing does not destroy the eigenvector property. The theorem also supplies existence of enough eigenvectors, which this short orthogonality calculation alone does not prove.

For A with rows (4,2),(2,4), the sum direction (1,1) scales by 6 and the difference direction (1,−1) scales by 2. Dividing both by √2 forms Q. A vector's squared length is the sum of squared coordinates in this basis, while xᵀAx becomes a weighted sum with weights 6 and 2. This connects the theorem to quadratic forms, principal axes and energy. For a nonsymmetric matrix, real eigenvalues alone do not guarantee an orthonormal eigenbasis.
body.zh:
实对称矩阵等于自身的转置。谱定理说明它的特征值均为实数，并且存在由特征向量组成的标准正交基。因此 A=QΛQᵀ，其中 Q 是正交矩阵，Λ 为实对角矩阵。QᵀQ=I，说明换到这一组坐标会保持长度和角度。它比普通可对角化更强，后者使用的基不一定正交，甚至可能数值上很不稳定。

不同特征值的方向为什么垂直？若 Au=λu、Av=μv，对称性给出 (Au)·v=u·(Av)，因此 λ(u·v)=μ(u·v)。当 λ≠μ，必有 u·v=0。重特征值的特征子空间内部可选标准正交基；由于线性组合仍在该特征子空间内，正交化不会破坏特征向量性质。谱定理还保证存在足够多的特征向量，这一点不能仅靠上述正交性计算证明。

例如 A 两行为 (4,2)、(2,4)，和方向 (1,1) 伸缩 6 倍，差方向 (1,−1) 伸缩 2 倍。各除以 √2 就得到 Q 的两列。在这组基下，长度平方仍是坐标平方和，而 xᵀAx 是以 6、2 为权重的平方和，因此可用于二次型、主轴和能量分析。非对称矩阵即使特征值全为实数，也未必有标准正交特征向量基。

body.en: The matrix with rows (2,1),(1,2) has eigenvectors (1,1),(1,−1), with eigenvalues 3 and 1. Normalizing divides each vector by √2.
The real symmetric hypothesis matters; arbitrary real matrices may have complex eigenvalues.
body.zh: 实对称条件重要，一般实矩阵可能有复特征值。

prompt.en: A has rows (5,2),(2,5). What is the eigenvalue in direction (1,−1)?

prompt.zh: 实对称矩阵中，不同特征值对应的特征向量必定……

text.en: parallel
text.zh: 平行

text.en: orthogonal
text.zh: 正交

text.en: equal in length
text.zh: 等长

hints.en: Compare (Au)·v with u·(Av).
hints.zh: 比较 (Au)·v 与 u·(Av)。

explanation.en: Symmetry gives (λ−μ)(u·v)=0. Distinct eigenvalues force the inner product to vanish; lengths remain freely scalable.
explanation.zh: 对称性给出 (λ−μ)(u·v)=0。不同特征值迫使内积为零，但长度可以任意缩放。

summary.en: SVD writes A=UΣVᵀ with orthonormal direction systems. Singular values are nonnegative square roots of eigenvalues of AᵀA.
summary.zh: SVD为A=UΣVᵀ，方向系正交归一；奇异值为AᵀA特征值的非负平方根。

objectives.en: Explain singular value and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释奇异值及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use left vectors in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用左奇异向量。

body.en: SVD writes A=UΣVᵀ with orthonormal direction systems. Singular values are nonnegative square roots of eigenvalues of AᵀA.
body.zh: SVD为A=UΣVᵀ，方向系正交归一；奇异值为AᵀA特征值的非负平方根。

body.en:
Singular value decomposition applies to rectangular matrices as well as square ones. For a real m-by-n matrix, A=UΣVᵀ, with U and V orthogonal and Σ rectangular diagonal with nonnegative entries. Read this as three operations: choose perpendicular input coordinates, stretch selected directions, then choose perpendicular output coordinates. Unlike eigenvectors, the input and output directions may live in spaces of different dimensions.

To see where the stretches come from, consider AᵀA. It is symmetric, and vᵀAᵀAv equals the nonnegative squared length of Av. Its eigenvalues are therefore nonnegative. Choose orthonormal eigenvectors vᵢ and set σᵢ to the square root of each eigenvalue. For σᵢ>0, define uᵢ=Avᵢ/σᵢ. Their inner products show that the uᵢ are orthonormal. Complete the missing output directions to obtain U. A zero singular value identifies an input direction annihilated by A.

For a matrix that maps (x,y) to (4x,−y,0), the singular values are 4 and 1: the minus sign changes direction, not stretch magnitude. The number of positive singular values is the rank. Retaining only the largest stretches gives useful low-rank approximations; discarding a stretch deliberately loses its contribution. In solving inverse problems, dividing by a tiny singular value amplifies measurement error, so rank thresholds and regularization depend on data accuracy rather than on algebra alone.
body.zh:
奇异值分解既适用于方阵，也适用于长方形矩阵。对实 m×n 矩阵，A=UΣVᵀ，其中 U、V 正交，Σ 为非负对角元组成的长方形对角矩阵。可把它理解为：选取垂直的输入坐标，沿这些方向伸缩，再选取垂直的输出坐标。与特征向量不同，输入、输出方向甚至可以位于不同维数的空间。

伸缩倍数来自 AᵀA。它是对称矩阵，并且 vᵀAᵀAv 等于 Av 的长度平方，所以非负，因此其特征值非负。取标准正交特征向量 vᵢ，令 σᵢ 为对应特征值平方根。σᵢ>0 时，定义 uᵢ=Avᵢ/σᵢ；计算内积可知这些 uᵢ 标准正交，再补齐输出方向得到 U。零奇异值对应被 A 映为零的输入方向。

例如映射 (x,y)→(4x,−y,0) 的奇异值为 4、1；负号改变方向，不改变伸缩量。正奇异值的个数就是秩。只保留较大的伸缩方向可以得到低秩近似，但丢掉某个方向就确实丢掉了它的贡献。求逆问题中，除以极小奇异值会放大测量误差，因此截断阈值和正则化还需考虑数据精度，不能只依赖形式代数。

body.en: For diag(3,−2), AᵀA=diag(9,4), so singular values are 3 and 2; signs are absorbed by direction vectors.
body.zh: diag(3,−2)的AᵀA为diag(9,4)，奇异值3与2，符号由方向向量吸收。

body.en: Singular values are not generally eigenvalues; they remain meaningful for rectangular matrices.
body.zh: 奇异值通常不等于特征值，矩形矩阵也有奇异值。

prompt.en: For A with diagonal entries −6 and 2, what is the largest singular value?
prompt.zh: 对角元为 −6、2 的矩阵 A，最大奇异值是多少？

hints.en: Square the entries in AᵀA, then take nonnegative square roots.
hints.zh: 先考虑 AᵀA 中的平方，再取非负平方根。

explanation.en: AᵀA has eigenvalues 36 and 4; its singular values are 6 and 2.
explanation.zh: AᵀA 的特征值为 36、4，所以奇异值为 6、2。

prompt.en: A has singular values 8,3,0,0. What is its rank?
prompt.zh: A 的奇异值为 8、3、0、0，它的秩是多少？

hints.en: Count positive singular values, not all displayed values.
hints.zh: 数正奇异值，而不是所有列出的数。

explanation.en: Two directions have nonzero stretch, so the image is two-dimensional and rank is 2.
explanation.zh: 两个方向的伸缩非零，因此像是二维，秩为 2。

summary.en: A symmetric quadratic form xᵀAx is positive definite when it is positive for every nonzero x, equivalently all eigenvalues are positive.
summary.zh: 对称二次型xᵀAx对所有非零x为正时正定，等价于所有特征值正。

objectives.en: Explain quadratic form and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释二次型及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use positive definite in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用正定。

body.en: A symmetric quadratic form xᵀAx is positive definite when it is positive for every nonzero x, equivalently all eigenvalues are positive.
body.zh: 对称二次型xᵀAx对所有非零x为正时正定，等价于所有特征值正。

body.en:
A quadratic form takes a vector and returns a homogeneous expression of degree two, such as 3x²+4xy+2y². Write it as xᵀAx using a symmetric matrix: the off-diagonal entry is half the coefficient of xy because two symmetric positions contribute that product. In fact any square matrix gives the same quadratic form as its symmetric part (A+Aᵀ)/2; its skew-symmetric part contributes zero.

Positive definite means the form is strictly positive on every nonzero vector. Positive semidefinite allows zero for some nonzero vectors but never a negative value. Negative versions reverse the signs. Indefinite means some inputs give positive values and others negative values. Testing a few convenient vectors cannot establish definiteness for every direction.

Use the spectral theorem: in orthonormal eigenvector coordinates, xᵀAx is a sum of eigenvalues times squared coordinates. All eigenvalues positive gives positive definiteness; all nonnegative gives semidefiniteness; a mixture of positive and negative gives indefiniteness. For a symmetric 2-by-2 matrix with entries a,b;b,c, positive definiteness is equivalent to a>0 and ac−b²>0. Completing the square gives a(x+by/a)²+(c−b²/a)y² when a is nonzero, explaining the criterion when a>0. Positive diagonal entries alone are insufficient: a large mixed term can create a negative direction. In optimization, a positive definite Hessian at a stationary point gives a strict local minimum under the usual twice-continuously-differentiable assumptions.
body.zh:
二次型将向量变成齐次二次表达式，例如 3x²+4xy+2y²。它可写成 xᵀAx，其中 A 取对称矩阵。非对角元应是 xy 系数的一半，因为两个对称位置都贡献同一个乘积。任何方阵的二次型都与其对称部分 (A+Aᵀ)/2 相同，反对称部分的贡献为零。

正定要求对所有非零向量取严格正值；半正定允许某些非零向量给零，但绝不取负值。负定、半负定把符号反过来。不定则表示有些输入为正、有些为负。仅试几个方便的向量，不能证明所有方向上的结论。

利用谱定理，在标准正交特征坐标中，xᵀAx 成为“特征值乘坐标平方”的和。所有特征值正则正定，全非负则半正定，正负都有则不定。对称 2×2 矩阵 a,b;b,c 正定的充要条件是 a>0 且 ac−b²>0。当 a≠0 时配方为 a(x+by/a)²+(c−b²/a)y²，a>0 时便解释了该判据。仅对角元为正不够，大的混合项仍可能产生负方向。在优化中，通常的二阶连续可微条件下，驻点处 Hessian 正定可保证严格局部极小。

summary.en: Similarity P⁻¹AP changes basis. Over the complex numbers, Jordan form records eigenvalues and any failure of diagonalizability through blocks.

body.en: Similarity P⁻¹AP changes basis. Over the complex numbers, Jordan form records eigenvalues and any failure of diagonalizability through blocks.
body.zh: 相似变换P⁻¹AP表示换基；复数域上的约旦形用块记录特征值及不可对角化程度。

body.en:
A matrix depends on a basis, but the linear map it represents does not. If columns of P are new basis vectors expressed in old coordinates, the same map has new matrix P⁻¹AP. Matrices related this way are similar. Similarity preserves eigenvalues, determinant, trace and ranks of powers, but generally does not preserve lengths of coordinate vectors because P need not be orthogonal.

Diagonal form is available only when eigenvectors supply a full basis. Over the complex numbers, Jordan form also handles the missing directions. A Jordan block has one eigenvalue along the diagonal and ones just above it. Its extra basis vectors are generalized eigenvectors: a chain satisfies (A−λI)v₁=0 and (A−λI)v₂=v₁, and may continue. The second vector is not an ordinary eigenvector; applying A mixes it with the earlier direction.

For J with rows (2,1),(0,2), write J=2I+N, where N²=0. Expanding J³ gives 8I+12N because terms containing N² vanish. Thus the upper-right entry grows with an additional polynomial factor, a feature that pure diagonal scaling misses. Block structure explains repeated modes in recurrences and differential equations. Jordan form is exact algebra over a field where the characteristic polynomial splits; tiny numerical perturbations can change its block structure. Numerical computation often uses more stable decompositions instead of trying to infer exact Jordan blocks from rounded data.
body.zh:
矩阵依赖于选定的基，线性映射本身却不依赖。若 P 的列是新基在旧坐标中的表示，则同一个映射在新基下的矩阵为 P⁻¹AP。这种关系称为相似。相似保持特征值、行列式、迹以及各次幂的秩，但一般不保持坐标向量的长度，因为 P 未必正交。

只有特征向量能够构成完整基时，才能化为对角形式。复数域上的 Jordan 形还能处理缺失的特征方向。每个 Jordan 块的对角线是同一特征值，其上方相邻位置为 1。额外的基向量是广义特征向量，构成链：(A−λI)v₁=0、(A−λI)v₂=v₁，还可继续。第二个并非普通特征向量，A 会将它与前一个方向混合。

例如 J 两行为 (2,1)、(0,2)，可写 J=2I+N，且 N²=0。展开 J³，因为含 N² 的项都消失，得到 8I+12N，因此右上角包含纯对角伸缩所没有的多项式增长因子。这种块结构有助于理解递推和微分方程中的重复模式。Jordan 形是在特征多项式能够完全分裂的数域上的精确代数描述；极小数值扰动可能改变块结构，因此不宜直接从舍入后的数据猜测精确 Jordan 块，数值计算常采用更稳定的分解。

body.en: J=[[2,1],[0,2]]=2I+N with N²=0. Thus J²=4I+4N=[[4,4],[0,4]], despite having only one independent eigenvector.

body.zh: 相似保持特征值，但不同于二次型的合同变换。

body.en: A multivariable limit must agree along every approach. A partial derivative varies one coordinate while fixing the others.
body.zh: 多元极限须沿所有趋近方式相同；偏导只改变一个坐标，其余固定。

body.en: Multivariable calculus distinguishes changing one coordinate from moving in an arbitrary direction. The derivative, when it exists, is a linear map that approximates the full change; partial derivatives are only its coordinate components. Gradients organize first-order change of scalar functions, while Jacobian matrices describe vector-valued maps. Integration accumulates over regions, curves, or surfaces using the corresponding length, area, or volume element. Coordinate changes require a Jacobian factor because equal coordinate increments need not represent equal physical volume. Orientation controls signs in circulation and flux. Check smoothness, domain geometry, and boundary orientation before applying a global integral theorem.
body.zh: 多元微积分区分改变一个坐标与沿任意方向移动。存在时，导数是近似整体变化的线性映射，偏导只是坐标分量。梯度组织标量函数的一阶变化，雅可比矩阵描述向量值映射。积分沿区域、曲线或曲面累积，需相应长度、面积或体积元。换坐标要乘雅可比因子，因为等坐标增量未必表示等物理体积。方向决定环流和通量符号；使用整体积分定理前要检查光滑性、区域和边界方向。

body.en: Multivariable calculus distinguishes changing one coordinate from moving in an arbitrary direction. The derivative, when it exists, is a linear map that approximates the full change; partial derivatives are only its coordinate components. body.en: A differential equation specifies how an unknown function and its derivatives are related. An initial condition selects a trajectory from a family, but existence and uniqueness depend on the equation and domain. Derive a model from conservation or a rate law, stating which quantities and parameters have physical meaning. Verify a proposed solution by differentiating and substituting into the original equation as well as checking initial data. Linear equations support superposition for homogeneous solutions; forcing adds a particular response. Numerical integration replaces continuous evolution by finite steps, introducing approximation and possible instability that must be checked by changing the step size.
body.zh: 微分方程规定未知函数与导数之间的关系。初值从解族中选轨道，但存在唯一性依方程和定义域而定。建模应从守恒或速率规律出发，说明量与参数的意义。验证解要对原方程代入并检查初值。线性齐次解可叠加，外力增加特解。数值积分用有限步替代连续演化，会引入误差或不稳定，应改变步长检查。

body.en: Analysis makes the limiting arguments of calculus precise. Definitions usually contain quantifiers whose order controls what must be uniform and what may depend on an earlier choice. To prove convergence, begin with an arbitrary positive tolerance and construct an index or neighborhood that guarantees the required estimate. Completeness supplies limits that rational numbers alone may lack. Compactness turns certain infinite local descriptions into finite control. Interchanging limits, sums, derivatives, and integrals requires a theorem with suitable hypotheses; pointwise agreement by itself is often too weak. Build both proofs and counterexamples to learn which assumptions carry the conclusion.

body.en: A group has an associative operation, identity, and inverses for every element. Commutativity is an additional property, not a group axiom.

body.en: Abstract algebra studies operations through their laws instead of the particular appearance of their elements. Begin with a set and a precisely defined operation, then verify closure, associativity, identity, and inverses when claiming a group. A structure-preserving map carries algebraic relationships between structures; its kernel identifies elements indistinguishable from the identity. Quotients turn compatible equivalence classes into new algebraic objects. Counting the sizes of cosets reveals divisibility constraints in finite groups. Rings have two operations, so ideals must respect multiplication as well as addition. Concrete permutations, integers modulo n, and polynomial examples should accompany every abstract definition.
body.zh: 抽象代数通过运算规律研究结构，而不依元素外观。声称群时，要给集合与运算并检查封闭、结合、单位元与逆元。保结构映射在结构之间传递代数关系，核标识与单位元无法区分的元素。商结构把相容等价类变为新对象；陪集计数给有限群整除限制。环有两种运算，所以理想除加法外还须与乘法相容。每个抽象定义都应配合置换、模整数和多项式实例。

body.en: Positive integers under addition lack both zero and additive inverses, so they do not form a group.

summary.en: Cosets of a subgroup partition a group into equal-sized sets. For a finite group, |G|=[G:H]|H|.

body.en: Cosets of a subgroup partition a group into equal-sized sets. For a finite group, |G|=[G:H]|H|.
body.zh: 子群陪集把群分成等大集合；有限群满足|G|=[G:H]|H|。

body.en: Abstract algebra studies operations through their laws instead of the particular appearance of their elements. Begin with a set and a precisely defined operation, then verify closure, associativity, identity, and inverses when claiming a group. A structure-preserving map carries algebraic relationships between structures; its kernel identifies elements indistinguishable from the identity. Quotients turn compatible equivalence classes into new algebraic objects. Counting the sizes of cosets reveals divisibility constraints in finite groups. Rings have two operations, so ideals must respect multiplication as well as addition. Concrete permutations, integers modulo n, and polynomial examples should accompany every abstract definition.
body.zh: 抽象代数通过运算规律研究结构，而不依元素外观。声称群时，要给集合与运算并检查封闭、结合、单位元与逆元。保结构映射在结构之间传递代数关系，核标识与单位元无法区分的元素。商结构把相容等价类变为新对象；陪集计数给有限群整除限制。环有两种运算，所以理想除加法外还须与乘法相容。每个抽象定义都应配合置换、模整数和多项式实例。

body.en: A divisor of group order need not always be the order of a subgroup.

title.zh: 有限群结构与西罗定理

summary.en: If p^k is the largest p-power dividing |G|, Sylow p-subgroups have size p^k. Their number divides |G|/p^k and is 1 modulo p.
summary.zh: p^k为群阶中最大p幂时，西罗p子群阶p^k；其个数整除剩余因子且模p余1。

objectives.en: Explain p-subgroup and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释p子群及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use Sylow subgroup in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用西罗子群。

body.en: If p^k is the largest p-power dividing |G|, Sylow p-subgroups have size p^k. Their number divides |G|/p^k and is 1 modulo p.
body.zh: p^k为群阶中最大p幂时，西罗p子群阶p^k；其个数整除剩余因子且模p余1。

body.en: Structure theory explains which algebraic objects can exist and how smaller pieces fit together. Finite-group counting constrains subgroup sizes but does not replace the group axioms. Modules generalize vector spaces by allowing scalars from a ring, where division may fail. Field extensions treat one field as a vector space over another, making degree a dimension. Automorphisms preserve algebraic relations and reveal symmetries among roots. Galois theory connects intermediate fields to subgroups only under precise normality and separability hypotheses. Keep examples small enough to calculate directly, and distinguish a theorem about all objects from a classification that applies only under its stated assumptions.
body.zh: 结构理论说明代数对象如何存在和拼合。有限群计数限制子群大小，却不取代群公理。模把标量从域推广到环，因此除法可能失败。域扩张把大域视为小域上的向量空间，次数就是维数。自同构保持代数关系，揭示根的对称性。伽罗瓦理论在正规与可分条件下连接中间域与子群。应计算小实例，并区分普遍定理与仅适用于指定假设的分类。

body.en: For |G|=15, the number of Sylow 5-subgroups divides 3 and is 1 mod 5, forcing 1. Hence that subgroup is normal.
body.zh: 群阶15时，西罗5子群个数整除3且模5余1，只能是1，因此正规。

body.en: The congruence and divisibility conditions are both required.
body.zh: 同余与整除条件须同时使用。

body.en: Number theory studies the structure of integers under divisibility. Euclidean division writes a=bq+r with a controlled remainder, and repeated division computes a greatest common divisor. Congruence replaces equality by equality of remainders, so every operation must respect the modulus. Inverses exist only for residue classes coprime to the modulus; cancellation without this condition can fail. Prime factorization converts many divisibility problems into exponent comparisons. Constructive proofs should give an actual integer or algorithm, while impossibility proofs often use modular obstructions or infinite descent. Check zero, negative values, and the modulus-one convention when applying a general formula.
body.zh: 数论研究整数的整除结构。欧氏除法写a=bq+r并控制余数，反复除法求最大公因数。同余以余数相等代替等号，运算须与模相容。逆元仅对与模互素的类存在，否则约分会失败。素因数分解把许多整除问题变成指数比较。构造证明须给实际整数或算法，不可能性常用同余障碍或无限递降。应用公式要检查零、负数与模一约定。

body.en: A gcd is chosen nonnegative; divisibility is not ordinary real-number division.

body.en: ax+by=c has integer solutions exactly when gcd(a,b) divides c. One solution generates a family by adding b/g to x and subtracting a/g from y.
body.zh: ax+by=c有整数解当且仅当gcd(a,b)整除c；一解可沿(b/g,−a/g)生成解族。

body.en: Number theory studies the structure of integers under divisibility. Euclidean division writes a=bq+r with a controlled remainder, and repeated division computes a greatest common divisor. Congruence replaces equality by equality of remainders, so every operation must respect the modulus. Inverses exist only for residue classes coprime to the modulus; cancellation without this condition can fail. Prime factorization converts many divisibility problems into exponent comparisons. Constructive proofs should give an actual integer or algorithm, while impossibility proofs often use modular obstructions or infinite descent. Check zero, negative values, and the modulus-one convention when applying a general formula.
body.zh: 数论研究整数的整除结构。欧氏除法写a=bq+r并控制余数，反复除法求最大公因数。同余以余数相等代替等号，运算须与模相容。逆元仅对与模互素的类存在，否则约分会失败。素因数分解把许多整除问题变成指数比较。构造证明须给实际整数或算法，不可能性常用同余障碍或无限递降。应用公式要检查零、负数与模一约定。

body.en: For 3x+5y=1, (x,y)=(2,−1) works. All integer solutions are x=2+5t,y=−1−3t.

body.en: Real solvability says little about integer solvability; a parameter must be integer.
body.zh: 实数可解不代表整数可解，参数须取整数。

body.en: Add counts for disjoint alternatives; multiply counts for successive choices with fixed available counts.
body.zh: 互斥选择用加法，逐步且选择数固定时用乘法。

body.en: Combinatorics counts finite structures by explaining how each structure is built or represented. The sum rule requires disjoint cases; the product rule requires a sequence of choices whose available counts are correctly conditioned. A bijection proves two counts equal by giving reversible maps, while double counting describes the same set of incidences in two ways. Recurrences classify objects by their final step or first distinguished part. Generating functions encode choices as exponents and counts as coefficients. Before calculating, specify whether order matters, repetition is allowed, and labels distinguish objects; changing any of these conventions changes the problem.
body.zh: 组合数学通过结构的构造或表示来计数。加法规则要求情况互斥，乘法规则要求正确考虑逐步选择数量。双射以可逆映射证明计数相等，双重计数从两种角度数同一关联集合。递推按最后一步或第一个特殊部分分类；生成函数以指数编码选择、系数编码个数。计算前须说明顺序、重复和标签是否重要，任一约定改变都可能改变问题。

body.en: Combinatorics counts finite structures by explaining how each structure is built or represented. The sum rule requires disjoint cases; the product rule requires a sequence of choices whose available counts are correctly conditioned. A bijection proves two counts equal by giving reversible maps, while double counting describes the same set of incidences in two ways. Recurrences classify objects by their final step or first distinguished part. Generating functions encode choices as exponents and counts as coefficients. Before calculating, specify whether order matters, repetition is allowed, and labels distinguish objects; changing any of these conventions changes the problem.
body.zh: 组合数学通过结构的构造或表示来计数。加法规则要求情况互斥，乘法规则要求正确考虑逐步选择数量。双射以可逆映射证明计数相等，双重计数从两种角度数同一关联集合。递推按最后一步或第一个特殊部分分类；生成函数以指数编码选择、系数编码个数。计算前须说明顺序、重复和标签是否重要，任一约定改变都可能改变问题。

body.en: Probability assigns weights to possible outcomes and adds the weights of disjoint events. Begin by specifying the experiment and sample space; outcomes are not automatically equally likely just because they can be listed. Conditioning restricts attention to an event and renormalizes its probability. Independence is a mathematical relation, not merely the absence of an obvious connection. body.en: Continuous probability uses densities whose integrals, rather than point values, give probabilities. A model describes a population or data-generating process; statistics uses observed samples to learn about that model. Sampling variability remains even with careful measurement. Separate parameters, which characterize the model, from estimators, which are functions of the sample. Confidence procedures and hypothesis tests have repeated-sampling interpretations and require their assumptions to be checked. Randomization, representative sampling, and residual diagnostics address different sources of error. State uncertainty alongside an estimate, and distinguish association, predictive usefulness, and causal interpretation instead of treating them as interchangeable.

body.en: For real x, x²≥0. Rearranging nonnegative squares yields many inequalities, and equality holds exactly when the squared expression vanishes.

body.en: Inequality proofs compare quantities while keeping domains and equality conditions visible. Start by identifying signs, symmetry, homogeneity, and any fixed sum or product. A valid inequality may reverse when multiplied by a negative value, and taking powers may require nonnegative inputs. Standard inequalities compress reusable arguments, but selecting substitutions is part of the proof: every term must satisfy the theorem’s hypotheses. Track equality through every step to see whether a proposed bound can actually be attained. Numerical trials can locate likely extremizers or counterexamples, but they do not establish a bound for all permitted real values.

body.en: Inequality proofs compare quantities while keeping domains and equality conditions visible. Start by identifying signs, symmetry, homogeneity, and any fixed sum or product. A valid inequality may reverse when multiplied by a negative value, and taking powers may require nonnegative inputs. Standard inequalities compress reusable arguments, but selecting substitutions is part of the proof: every term must satisfy the theorem’s hypotheses. Track equality through every step to see whether a proposed bound can actually be attained. Numerical trials can locate likely extremizers or counterexamples, but they do not establish a bound for all permitted real values.

body.en: Olympiad problem solving combines proof methods rather than selecting formulas by surface resemblance. Translate the statement into exact constraints, test small or extreme cases, and look for invariants, symmetry, divisibility, or a useful auxiliary object. Exploration may be informal, but the final proof must explain every case and justify that a construction meets the original conditions. When an approach fails, identify the specific obstruction instead of merely trying more algebra. Timed practice should be followed by reconstruction without the solution and by variations that change a hypothesis. A complete argument includes existence, uniqueness, or exhaustiveness whenever the question requests them.
body.zh: 竞赛解题组合证明方法，而非凭表面套公式。先把题意化为精确约束，试小值或极端情况，寻找不变量、对称、整除或辅助对象。探索可以非正式，最终证明必须涵盖全部情况并核对构造满足原条件。方法失败时应指出障碍，而不只是继续堆代数。限时练习之后应脱离答案重建，并改变假设迁移。题目要求存在、唯一或穷尽时，完整论证须分别证明。

Exploration may be informal, but the final proof must explain every case and justify that a construction meets the original conditions. When an approach fails, identify the specific obstruction instead of merely trying more algebra. Timed practice should be followed by reconstruction without the solution and by variations that change a hypothesis. A complete argument includes existence, uniqueness, or exhaustiveness whenever the question requests them.
body.zh: 竞赛解题组合证明方法，而非凭表面套公式。先把题意化为精确约束，试小值或极端情况，寻找不变量、对称、整除或辅助对象。探索可以非正式，最终证明必须涵盖全部情况并核对构造满足原条件。方法失败时应指出障碍，而不只是继续堆代数。限时练习之后应脱离答案重建，并改变假设迁移。题目要求存在、唯一或穷尽时，完整论证须分别证明。

body.en: The complex derivative is lim[h→0](f(z+h)−f(z))/h with h approaching through all complex directions.
body.zh: 复导数要求h从所有复方向趋零时差商有共同极限。

body.en: Complex differentiability is stronger than differentiability in two real coordinates because the same difference quotient must work from every complex direction. Holomorphic functions are complex differentiable throughout an open neighborhood, and this local requirement creates powerful global consequences under appropriate domain assumptions. Contour integration depends on orientation and on singularities enclosed by a path. Cauchy formulas link values inside a region to boundary information, while Laurent expansions isolate the terms responsible for residues. Always identify the domain, branches of multivalued expressions, and locations of singularities before using a theorem or deforming a contour.
body.zh: 复可导比两个实坐标的可微更强，因为所有复方向差商须有同一极限。全纯要求在开邻域处处复可导，在适当区域假设下会产生强整体结论。围道积分依方向及包围奇点而定；柯西公式连接内部值与边界信息，洛朗展开分离留数相关项。使用定理或变形围道前，须明确区域、多值表达式的分支与奇点位置。

body.zh: f=z²差商2z+h，故导数2z；z=1+i时为2+2i。

body.en: Real differentiability alone does not imply complex differentiability; conjugation fails the direction test.

body.en: A topology includes empty and full sets, arbitrary unions, and finite intersections. A basis generates open sets by unions.
body.zh: 拓扑含空集与全集，对任意并、有限交封闭；基通过并生成开集。

body.en: Topology studies properties preserved by continuous deformation using open sets rather than a fixed measuring scale. A topology specifies which subsets are open and must satisfy union and finite-intersection axioms. Continuity is naturally phrased using preimages of open sets, allowing the same definition in spaces without a metric. Products combine spaces, while quotients identify points according to a relation. Compactness and connectedness describe different global properties and must not be conflated. Homeomorphisms preserve all topological properties, so finding a property that differs can disprove their existence even when two drawings look similar.
body.zh: 拓扑用开集而非固定尺度研究连续变形保持的性质。拓扑规定开子集并满足并与有限交公理。连续性用开集原像表述，可用于没有度量的空间。积组合空间，商按关系识别点。紧致与连通描述不同整体性质，不能混淆。同胚保持全部拓扑性质，因此找到差异性质即可否定同胚，即使图形看似相近。

body.en: Differential geometry studies shapes using local calculus while separating intrinsic properties from the way a shape sits in ambient space. A regular parameterization provides coordinate directions, but different parameters may describe the same geometric object. Derivatives determine tangent vectors and tangent planes; second-order change describes bending. The first fundamental form measures lengths and angles on a surface, while the second records normal bending in space. Curvature can vary by direction. Geodesics locally generalize straight paths, but global shortest paths may require additional comparison. Check regularity and coordinate singularities before attributing a computational failure to the shape itself.
body.zh: 微分几何用局部微积分研究形状，并区分内在性质与空间嵌入方式。正则参数化提供坐标方向，不同参数可表示同一对象。导数确定切向量与切平面，二阶变化描述弯曲。第一基本形式测表面长度与角，第二记录空间法向弯曲。曲率可依方向变化；测地线局部推广直线，整体最短还需比较。应检查正则性与坐标奇点，不能把计算失败都归于形状本身。

body.en: For a surface patch r(u,v), independent partial derivatives r_u,r_v span the tangent plane. Their cross product provides a normal.
body.zh: 曲面片r(u,v)的独立偏导r_u、r_v张成切平面，叉积给法向。

body.en: Differential geometry studies shapes using local calculus while separating intrinsic properties from the way a shape sits in ambient space. A regular parameterization provides coordinate directions, but different parameters may describe the same geometric object. Derivatives determine tangent vectors and tangent planes; second-order change describes bending. The first fundamental form measures lengths and angles on a surface, while the second records normal bending in space. Curvature can vary by direction. Geodesics locally generalize straight paths, but global shortest paths may require additional comparison. Check regularity and coordinate singularities before attributing a computational failure to the shape itself.
body.zh: 微分几何用局部微积分研究形状，并区分内在性质与空间嵌入方式。正则参数化提供坐标方向，不同参数可表示同一对象。导数确定切向量与切平面，二阶变化描述弯曲。第一基本形式测表面长度与角，第二记录空间法向弯曲。曲率可依方向变化；测地线局部推广直线，整体最短还需比较。应检查正则性与坐标奇点，不能把计算失败都归于形状本身。

body.en: For graph z=x²+y² at (1,2,5), tangent plane is z−5=2(x−1)+4(y−2).
A zero cross product signals a nonregular parameterization, not automatically a singular surface.
body.zh: 叉积零表示参数化不正则，不一定曲面本身奇异。

body.en: Floating-point numbers approximate real values with finite precision. Conditioning measures how much output changes relative to input perturbations.
body.zh: 浮点以有限精度近似实数；条件性度量输入扰动引起的相对输出变化。

body.en: Numerical mathematics studies algorithms that approximate mathematical quantities using finite computation. Separate conditioning of the underlying problem from stability of the chosen algorithm: a stable method cannot make an inherently sensitive problem insensitive. Track truncation error, rounding error, and stopping criteria rather than reporting many digits without evidence. Root finding, linear solves, interpolation, and optimization should be verified using residuals, known bounds, and independent changes of resolution. Convexity gives powerful guarantees about global optima, but constraints and domain assumptions remain essential. A numerical result is an approximation with evidence, not automatically an exact proof of existence, uniqueness, or optimality.
body.zh: 数值数学研究有限计算近似数学量。应区分问题条件性与算法稳定性，稳定算法不能消除问题本身的敏感性。须跟踪截断、舍入和停止准则，而非无依据多报数字。求根、线性求解、插值和优化应用残差、已知界及改变分辨率核验。凸性提供整体最优保证，但约束与定义域仍重要。数值结果是有证据的近似，不自动构成存在、唯一或最优的精确证明。

body.en: Subtracting 1.000001−1=0.000001 retains few reliable digits if the inputs were already rounded. Algebraic reformulation can avoid some harmful cancellation.
body.zh: 1.000001−1=0.000001若输入已有舍入，剩余可靠数字很少；代数改写可避免部分消去。

body.en: Small residuals do not ensure small solution error for ill-conditioned problems.
body.zh: 病态问题中残差小不保证解误差小。

body.en: Numerical mathematics studies algorithms that approximate mathematical quantities using finite computation. Separate conditioning of the underlying problem from stability of the chosen algorithm: a stable method cannot make an inherently sensitive problem insensitive. Track truncation error, rounding error, and stopping criteria rather than reporting many digits without evidence. Root finding, linear solves, interpolation, and optimization should be verified using residuals, known bounds, and independent changes of resolution. Convexity gives powerful guarantees about global optima, but constraints and domain assumptions remain essential. A numerical result is an approximation with evidence, not automatically an exact proof of existence, uniqueness, or optimality.

summary.en: Alleles are alternative versions at a locus.
summary.zh: 等位基因是同一位点的不同版本。

objectives.en: Explain alleles using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释等位基因。

objectives.en: Apply segregation and check genotype and phenotype.
objectives.zh: 应用分离，并检查基因型与表型。

body.en: A gene is a functional genetic unit, while a locus identifies a genomic position and an allele is a version at that locus. In a diploid organism, homologous chromosomes usually provide two copies of each autosomal locus. Meiosis separates homologues and then sister chromatids, producing gametes with one copy per locus in the simple model. Fertilization combines two gametes and restores the diploid state. Genotype describes the allele combination; phenotype is an observed characteristic influenced by genotype and conditions. Complete dominance means a heterozygote resembles one homozygote for the specified phenotype. In incomplete dominance it is intermediate, and in codominance both allele-associated features can be detected. These terms do not rank evolutionary fitness or population frequency. A Punnett square enumerates possible gamete combinations and their probabilities; it does not guarantee exact counts in a small family. Independent assortment applies to suitably unlinked loci, whereas linked loci can violate the simple product-ratio prediction. Always state the inheritance assumptions, including equal segregation, viability and penetrance, before translating a cross into a predicted phenotypic ratio.
body.zh: 基因是功能遗传单位，位点指基因组位置，等位基因是该位点版本。二倍体同源染色体通常给常染色体位点两份。减数分裂先分同源染色体再分姐妹单体，简单模型下每配子每位点一份；受精合并配子恢复二倍体。基因型是等位组合，表型是受基因型及条件影响的观察特征。完全显性指杂合子在指定表型上像某纯合子；不完全显性居中，共显性可检测两种等位相关特征。这些术语不排名适合度或频率。棋盘列配子组合与概率，不保证小家庭精确计数。独立分配适用于合适非连锁位点，连锁可违反简单乘积比例。预测表型比前须明确等分离、存活与外显等假设。

title.zh: 等位基因 · 分离 · 基因型与表型

body.en: Alleles are alternative versions at a locus. Diploid individuals carry two copies, which segregate into gametes during meiosis. Dominance describes a heterozygote’s phenotype under specified conditions, not an allele’s frequency or superiority.
body.zh: 等位基因是同一位点的不同版本。二倍体携带两份，减数分裂时分离到配子。显隐性描述指定条件下杂合子的表型，不代表频率或优劣。

body.en: For Aa × Aa with equal segregation, find probability of aa. Apply the relation step by step: P(aa) = P(a from each parent) = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: Aa × Aa 且等概率分离，aa 概率是多少？逐步代入关系：P(aa) = P(a from each parent) = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “Dominant means the allele must be most common.” is not valid. A dominant allele can be rare in a population. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “显性意味着该等位基因必最常见。”并不成立。显性等位基因在种群中仍可罕见。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Before applying the relation to a new situation, draw the system boundary and identify what is measured, what is inferred and what is assumed constant. Change one parameter and predict the direction of the result before calculating. This separates understanding of a model from memorizing one numerical answer. This introductory survey establishes the named ideas; extended derivations, laboratory competence and comprehensive examination preparation require further study and review.

summary.en: Pedigrees constrain inheritance models through related individuals.
summary.zh: 系谱通过亲属限制遗传模型。

objectives.en: Explain conditional probability using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释条件概率。

objectives.en: Apply pedigrees and check penetrance.
objectives.zh: 应用系谱，并检查外显率。

body.en: A pedigree records relationships and observed traits, allowing candidate inheritance models to make different predictions. Begin by identifying affected and unaffected individuals, sexes, mating relationships and generation structure without assuming a model from one striking pair. Autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive and sex-linked models imply different possible genotypes, but small pedigrees often fit more than one explanation. An unaffected child of two heterozygous parents for a fully penetrant recessive trait is not sampled from all four Punnett outcomes; the affected outcome has been excluded, leaving three equally weighted possibilities, two of which are carriers. This is conditional probability. Penetrance is the probability that a genotype produces the defined phenotype under specified conditions; expressivity concerns the degree or form of that phenotype. Incomplete penetrance, age of onset, new mutations and environmental effects can obscure simple patterns. Related events are not automatically independent, so use shared parental genotype uncertainty consistently. A pedigree supports probabilities and model comparisons rather than certainty about every unobserved genotype. Distinguish educational inheritance calculations from clinical diagnosis, which requires additional evidence and professional interpretation.
body.zh: 系谱记录亲缘与表型，使候选遗传模型产生不同预测。先识别患与未患、性别、配偶及世代，不要凭显眼的一对就定模型。常显、常隐、性连锁允许不同基因型，但小系谱常兼容多个解释。完全外显隐性性状中，两杂合亲本的未患孩子不再从四种结果取样，因为患病结果已排除；剩三种等权可能，两种为携带者，这是条件概率。外显率是指定条件下某基因型产生定义表型的概率，表现度则指程度或形式。不完全外显、起病年龄、新突变及环境会遮蔽简单模式。亲属事件不自动独立，应一致处理共同亲本基因型的不确定性。系谱支持概率和模型比较，而非所有未测基因型的确定结论。教学计算也不同于需更多证据的临床诊断。

title.zh: 条件概率 · 系谱 · 外显率

body.en: Pedigrees constrain inheritance models through related individuals. Use conditional probabilities when observed phenotype excludes genotypes. Incomplete penetrance, new mutation and small family size can make a simple inheritance pattern ambiguous.
body.zh: 系谱通过亲属限制遗传模型。观察表型排除基因型后应使用条件概率。不完全外显、新突变和小家庭可使简单遗传模式难以唯一判断。

body.en: Among unaffected offspring of Aa × Aa for a fully penetrant recessive trait, find carrier probability. Apply the relation step by step: Unaffected genotypes: AA, Aa, aA; 2 of 3 are carriers. Check the units and the assumptions used.

body.en: The statement “Carrier probability remains one half regardless of pedigree evidence.” is not valid. Conditioning on an observed phenotype changes the relevant sample space. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “无论系谱证据如何，携带者概率总为二分之一。”并不成立。以观察表型为条件会改变样本空间。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

summary.en: Nearby loci on one chromosome often travel together.

objectives.en: Apply crossing over and check map distance.
objectives.zh: 应用交换，并检查遗传图距。

body.en: Genes on the same chromosome are physically linked, but crossing over during meiosis can exchange segments between homologues. A heterozygote’s phase specifies which alleles share a chromosome, such as AB/ab versus Ab/aB, and changes which offspring classes count as parental or recombinant. A testcross can reveal gamete types when the other parent contributes a known recessive combination. Recombination fraction is recombinant offspring divided by informative total, subject to assumptions about viability and scoring. For short intervals, one percent recombination corresponds approximately to one centimorgan. Over longer intervals, multiple crossovers can restore the original endpoint combination, making observed recombination underestimate the number of exchanges. The two-locus fraction approaches one half, so a value near one half can describe unlinked loci or widely separated loci on one chromosome. Three-point crosses add information about gene order and double crossovers. Genetic distance measures recombination behavior and is not a fixed conversion to physical base-pair distance because recombination rates vary along chromosomes and across biological contexts. Count classes carefully and state the mapping model rather than treating percentages as a literal ruler.
body.zh: 同染色体基因物理连锁，但减数交换可在同源间交换片段。杂合体相位说明哪些等位在同一染色体，如 AB/ab 与 Ab/aB，决定哪些后代算亲本型或重组型。测交另一亲本提供已知隐性组合，可显露配子类型。重组率是重组后代除以信息性总数，需假定存活和判分无偏。短区间百分之一重组近似一厘摩，长区间多次交换可恢复端点组合，使观测低估交换次数。两位点率趋近二分之一，因此近二分之一既可不连锁，也可同染色体相距很远。三点测交增加基因顺序与双交换信息。遗传距离描述重组行为，因位置和生物背景不同，不能固定换算碱基对。应仔细计类并说明模型，不能把百分比当实体尺。

body.en: Chromosomal variation changes the number or arrangement of large DNA segments. Aneuploidy adds or removes particular chromosomes, whereas polyploidy changes whole chromosome sets. Nondisjunction during a division can produce cells or gametes with unequal chromosome numbers; the consequences depend on which division and chromosome are involved. Structural variants include deletions, duplications, inversions and translocations. A deletion can remove genes, a duplication can alter dosage, and a breakpoint can interrupt a gene or separate it from regulatory sequences. An inversion preserves total DNA amount in its simplest form but can affect pairing and recombination. A balanced translocation may preserve material overall while creating reproductive risks or disrupting function at breakpoints. Mosaicism means different cells in one organism carry different genetic states, often because a change occurred after fertilization. Detecting a variant requires a method suited to its scale: a conventional chromosome image does not reveal every small sequence change. Phenotypic effects depend on dosage sensitivity, genomic location, cell distribution and environment, so neither “balanced” nor “large” alone determines the biological outcome.
body.zh: 染色体变异改变大片 DNA 数量或排列。非整倍性增减特定染色体，多倍性改变整套染色体。某次分裂不分离可使细胞或配子染色体数不等，后果依发生阶段和染色体。结构变异含缺失、重复、倒位和易位：缺失移去基因，重复改剂量，断点可打断基因或使其脱离调控。简单倒位总 DNA 量不变，却可影响配对与重组；平衡易位可总量守恒而仍带来繁殖风险或断点功能破坏。嵌合指个体不同细胞具有不同遗传状态，常来自受精后变化。检测方法须匹配尺度，普通染色体图不能发现所有小序列改变。表型依剂量敏感性、位置、细胞分布和环境，不能单凭“平衡”或“很大”判断后果。

summary.en: Many traits reflect multiple loci and environment.
summary.zh: 许多性状由多位点和环境共同影响。

objectives.en: Explain polygenic traits using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释多基因性状。

objectives.en: Apply allele frequencies and check hardy–weinberg model.
objectives.zh: 应用等位基因频率，并检查哈代—温伯格模型。

body.en: Many traits vary continuously because multiple genetic effects combine with environmental influences and measurement variation. A quantitative trait can still have particular large-effect loci, but its distribution is not necessarily explained by one dominant–recessive pair. Population genetics shifts attention from a single family to allele and genotype frequencies. Count alleles carefully: each diploid homozygote contributes two copies of one allele and each heterozygote contributes one of each. Under the Hardy–Weinberg reference conditions, random union of gametes produces genotype frequencies p², 2pq and q² for two alleles whose frequencies sum to one. The model assumes an appropriate mating structure and excludes evolutionary changes such as selection, migration, mutation and drift in its idealized long-term form. Deviations can suggest violated assumptions but do not identify one unique cause. Heritability partitions observed variation statistically within a specified population and environment. It is not the fraction of one individual caused by genes, nor does a high value mean that environmental intervention is ineffective. Gene–environment interaction means the effect of a genotype can change across environments, further limiting simplistic genetic determinism.
body.zh: 许多性状连续变化，因多基因效应叠加环境与测量变异；数量性状仍可能有大效应位点，但不一定由一对显隐基因解释。群体遗传关注等位和基因型频率。二倍体纯合贡献某等位两份，杂合各一份。哈代—温伯格参照中，两等位频率 p、q 和为一，随机配子结合给 p²、2pq、q²。模型要求合适交配结构，理想长期形式排除选择、迁移、突变和漂变等变化。偏离提示假设可能失效，却不能唯一识别原因。遗传力在指定种群环境内统计分解变异，不是一个人由基因造成的比例，高值也不表示环境干预无效。基因—环境互作意味着同一基因型效应随环境改变，进一步限制简单遗传决定论。

title.zh: 多基因性状 · 等位基因频率 · 哈代—温伯格模型

body.en: Many traits reflect multiple loci and environment. Population genetics tracks allele frequencies; under random mating and ideal assumptions, two-allele genotype frequencies are p², 2pq and q². This is a testable reference model.

objectives.en: Explain cross design using the stated model.

objectives.en: Apply complementation and check causal interpretation.
objectives.zh: 应用互补检验，并检查因果解释。

body.en: A genetic experiment becomes informative when competing explanations predict different outcomes. Choose a cross, perturbation or rescue that distinguishes those explanations rather than merely reproducing the original phenotype. A testcross can expose gamete types, while reciprocal crosses can reveal maternal, cytoplasmic or sex-linked effects under suitable designs. Complementation tests bring two recessive mutations together; restoration of function often suggests defects in different genes, but intragenic complementation, dominant effects and dosage interactions create exceptions. A rescue experiment asks whether restoring a normal component reverses a defect, strengthening causal interpretation when appropriate controls exclude nonspecific effects. Expected Mendelian ratios are probabilities, so finite samples fluctuate; compare observed counts with an appropriate sampling model instead of declaring every deviation a new mechanism. Environmental conditions, genetic background and viability can alter the observed classes. Distinguish correlation with a marker from proof that the marker itself causes the phenotype. Strong conclusions combine inheritance, molecular identity, perturbation and rescue evidence. Report which hypotheses the experiment excludes and which remain compatible, because one successful cross rarely proves an entire causal pathway on its own.
body.zh: 遗传实验在竞争解释预测不同结果时最有信息。应选能区分解释的杂交、扰动或挽救，而非仅重复原表型。测交显示配子类型，正反交在合适设计下可揭示母体、胞质或性连锁效应。互补把两个隐性突变放一起，功能恢复常提示不同基因缺陷，但基因内互补、显性及剂量作用有例外。挽救检验恢复正常组分是否逆转缺陷，适当对照排除非特异效应后加强因果。孟德尔比是概率，有限样本有波动，应比较采样模型而非每次偏离都宣称新机制。环境、遗传背景与存活可改变观察分类。须区分与标记相关和标记本身致因，强结论结合遗传、分子身份、扰动和挽救证据。说明排除与仍相容假设，一次成功杂交通常不能证明整条因果路径。

summary.en: Cells are fundamental units of organisms and arise from pre-existing cells.
summary.zh: 细胞是生物基本单位，来自已有细胞。

objectives.en: Explain cell theory using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释细胞学说。

objectives.en: Apply prokaryotes and eukaryotes and check scale.

body.en: Cell theory connects observations from many organisms: living organisms consist of cells, the cell is a basic organizational unit, and new cells arise from existing cells. This does not imply that every biological entity, such as a virus, is itself a cell. All cells have a boundary membrane, an internal aqueous environment, genetic information and machinery for using that information, though specialized mature cells can lose some components. Prokaryotic cells include bacteria and archaea and lack a membrane-bounded nucleus. Eukaryotic cells contain a nucleus and other membrane-bounded compartments, although their sizes and structures vary widely. A tissue is an organized collection of interacting cells, organs combine tissues, and organ systems coordinate functions. These levels are related but not interchangeable explanations. Small cells have relatively more surface area per volume, which affects exchange with the environment. A large organism therefore commonly consists of many cells rather than one proportionally enlarged cell. Microscopes and stains reveal only selected features, so drawings are simplified models. Learn to connect each structure with a function and the evidence supporting it rather than treating a labeled diagram as a complete inventory of every cell.
body.zh: 细胞学说综合多种生物观察：生物由细胞构成，细胞是基本组织单位，新细胞来自已有细胞；这不意味着病毒等每种生物实体本身都是细胞。细胞具有膜边界、内部水环境、遗传信息及利用信息的机器，但特化成熟细胞可失去部分成分。细菌和古菌属于原核细胞，没有膜包围细胞核。真核有细胞核及其他膜区室，大小结构仍广泛变化。组织是相互作用的细胞集合，器官组合组织，系统协调功能；这些解释层次相关却不能互换。小细胞表面积相对体积更大，影响环境交换，因此大型个体通常由更多细胞组成，而非一个同比放大细胞。显微与染色仅显示部分特征，课图是简化模型。应把结构、功能和证据联系起来，而非把标注图当每种细胞的完整库存。

body.en: The membrane’s amphipathic lipids arrange with hydrophilic regions facing water and hydrophobic regions inward. Small nonpolar molecules can cross the lipid region more readily than ions or many polar solutes. Channels provide selective pathways, while carriers bind and change conformation; their transport can saturate when binding sites are occupied. Diffusion produces net movement down a chemical-potential gradient even though individual molecules move in both directions. For ions, electrical and concentration effects combine into an electrochemical gradient. Primary active transport directly couples to an energy-releasing process such as ATP hydrolysis, while secondary active transport uses a gradient established elsewhere. Osmosis concerns water movement driven by water’s chemical potential across a boundary with unequal permeabilities. Tonicity predicts sustained cell-volume effects and depends on effectively nonpenetrating solutes, so it is not identical to total osmolarity in every case. Animal cells may swell or shrink when external conditions change; cell walls alter the mechanical outcome in plants. Predict transport by identifying the species, permeability, both sides’ conditions and the available energy coupling, not by assuming all movement follows one concentration arrow.
body.zh: 膜脂两亲性使亲水区朝水、疏水区向内。小非极性分子比离子和许多极性溶质更易穿脂区。通道提供选择通路，载体结合并变构，位点占满时可饱和。扩散虽每个分子双向运动，却沿化学势梯度产生净流；离子还需合并电势形成电化学梯度。初级主动运输直接耦合 ATP 水解等放能过程，次级主动运输利用其他过程建立的梯度。渗透是不同透过边界两侧水化学势驱动的移动。张性预测持续体积影响，依赖有效不透过溶质，并非所有情形下等同总渗透浓度。动物细胞可涨缩，植物细胞壁改变力学结局。预测应明确物种、透过性、两侧条件及能量耦合，不能把一切归为一个浓度箭头。

body.en: Compartmentation allows a cell to maintain chemically different spaces while controlling traffic between them. The nuclear envelope separates most eukaryotic DNA from the cytoplasm, and nuclear pores regulate exchange of selected molecules. Ribosomes translate RNA into proteins; free and membrane-associated ribosomes use the same basic machinery, but targeting signals direct some growing proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum. The ER participates in protein processing and lipid synthesis, while the Golgi modifies and sorts cargo for different destinations. Vesicles carry selected cargo rather than randomly blending all compartments. Lysosomes or related degradative compartments maintain conditions suited to breaking down material, and peroxisomes perform particular oxidative reactions. Mitochondria convert energy through respiratory processes, while chloroplasts in photosynthetic eukaryotes capture light energy; both retain distinctive membranes and genetic systems consistent with endosymbiotic origins. The cytoskeleton organizes shape, movement and intracellular transport. These structures are dynamic, not fixed isolated bags. A protein’s location depends on targeting information, transport machinery and cell state, so disrupting localization can impair function even when the protein’s chemical sequence is unchanged.
body.zh: 区室化使细胞维持不同化学空间并控制运输。核膜把大部分真核 DNA 与胞质隔开，核孔调节选择性交换。核糖体把 RNA 翻译成蛋白；游离和膜结合核糖体基本机器相同，但定位信号把部分新生蛋白导向内质网。内质网参与蛋白加工和脂质合成，高尔基体修饰分选货物。囊泡选择性载货，并非随机混匀区室。溶酶体等降解区室维持适于分解的条件，过氧化物酶体执行特定氧化反应。线粒体通过呼吸转能，光合真核的叶绿体捕获光能，两者特殊膜与遗传系统符合内共生起源。细胞骨架组织形状、运动及胞内运输。细胞器动态而非孤立固定袋子。蛋白位置依定位信息、运输机器和细胞状态，即使序列不变，定位受损仍可破坏功能。

body.en: Cells need both materials for construction and usable free energy to maintain organization. Catabolic reactions break down or oxidize molecules, while anabolic reactions assemble cellular components; the two are linked through intermediates and energy carriers. Enzymes accelerate selected transformations by stabilizing a favorable reaction pathway, but they do not alter the overall thermodynamic equilibrium. Active sites bind substrates in environments suited to catalysis, and activity can depend on pH, temperature, cofactors and regulatory molecules. ATP is continually formed and consumed in coupled processes. Its hydrolysis is useful only when an actual molecular mechanism connects it to transport, synthesis or movement. Electron carriers transfer reducing equivalents between reactions, and membranes can maintain ion gradients that store electrochemical free energy. Cellular respiration and photosynthesis use different sources and pathways but both involve controlled electron transfer and membrane organization. Matter and energy must be tracked separately: carbon atoms cycle through molecules, whereas usable energy is progressively dispersed. A cell can maintain stable concentrations while molecules turn over rapidly, so a steady snapshot does not indicate that biochemical reactions have stopped.
body.zh: 细胞既需构建材料，也需可用自由能维持组织。分解代谢分解或氧化分子，合成代谢构建成分，两者经中间体和能量载体连接。酶稳定合适路径以加速特定转化，但不改变总热力学平衡。活性位点提供适合催化的环境，活性依赖 pH、温度、辅因子和调节分子。ATP 持续生成消耗，只有存在实际分子机制将水解与运输、合成或运动连接时，水解才有用。电子载体转移还原当量，膜可维持储存电化学自由能的离子梯度。呼吸与光合来源路径不同，但都涉及受控电子转移和膜组织。物质与能量须分别追踪：碳原子在分子间循环，可用能量逐渐分散。细胞浓度稳定仍可快速周转，因此静态快照不表示生化反应停止。

objectives.zh: 应用有丝分裂，并检查细胞周期控制。

body.en: The eukaryotic cell cycle separates growth, DNA replication and chromosome segregation into coordinated phases. During G1 a cell grows and responds to conditions; S phase duplicates DNA; G2 prepares for division; mitosis partitions replicated chromosomes. A replicated chromosome contains two sister chromatids joined until their separation. Chromosome count is conventionally based on centromeres, so doubling DNA in S phase does not immediately double that count. During mitosis, condensed chromosomes attach to spindle microtubules, align and separate so each daughter nucleus receives an appropriate set. Cytokinesis divides the cytoplasm and differs mechanically between animal and plant cells. Checkpoints monitor events such as DNA integrity and spindle attachment, while cyclins and associated kinases coordinate transitions. A checkpoint is a regulatory process rather than a conscious inspection, and failures can permit abnormal proliferation or chromosome imbalance. Some differentiated cells exit the active cycle, while others divide frequently. Meiosis is a distinct specialized program that reduces chromosome sets and generates variation for sexual reproduction; it must not be confused with ordinary mitotic production of genetically similar daughter cells.
body.zh: 真核细胞周期协调分开生长、DNA 复制和染色体分离。G1 生长并响应条件，S 复制 DNA，G2 准备分裂，有丝分裂分配染色体。复制染色体含两条姐妹染色单体，分离前相连。按着丝粒计数时，S 期 DNA 加倍不立即使染色体数加倍。有丝分裂中染色体凝缩、连接纺锤微管、排列并分离，使子核获得适当集合。胞质分裂分开胞质，动物与植物机制不同。检查点监测 DNA 完整性和纺锤连接，周期蛋白及相关激酶协调转变。检查点是调控过程而非有意识检查，失效可导致异常增殖或染色体失衡。一些分化细胞退出活跃周期，另一些频繁分裂。减数分裂是减半染色体组并产生变异的特殊程序，不能与普通有丝分裂混淆。

title.zh: DNA 复制 · 有丝分裂 · 细胞周期控制

body.en: The cell cycle coordinates growth, DNA replication and division. Mitosis separates replicated sister chromatids, while cytokinesis divides the cell. Checkpoints and regulatory proteins help prevent division with incomplete or damaged genetic material.
body.zh: 细胞周期协调生长、DNA 复制与分裂。有丝分裂分离复制后的姐妹染色单体，胞质分裂分开细胞。检查点与调控蛋白帮助防止未完成或受损遗传物质进入分裂。

body.en: A cell has 4 chromosomes before DNA replication. Immediately after replication, how many sister chromatids are present? Apply the relation step by step: 4 replicated chromosomes × 2 sister chromatids = 8. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 细胞复制前有四条染色体，复制完成后共有几条姐妹染色单体？逐步代入关系：4 replicated chromosomes × 2 sister chromatids = 8.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “DNA replication and cell division are the same event.” is not valid. DNA amount doubles before mitosis without immediately doubling chromosome count by centromeres. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

summary.en: Cells detect selected signals through receptors and convert them into intracellular responses.
summary.zh: 细胞通过受体检测特定信号并转为胞内响应。

objectives.en: Explain receptors using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释受体。

objectives.en: Apply signal transduction and check imaging limits.
objectives.zh: 应用信号转导，并检查成像限制。

body.en: Cell signaling begins when a stimulus changes a receptor or another sensing molecule. A receptor’s location and binding specificity determine which signals a cell can detect, and the same signal can produce different responses in different cell types because their internal networks differ. Transduction relays the information through protein interactions, phosphorylation, second messengers or changes in gene expression. Cascades can amplify a small input, while feedback and signal termination prevent indefinite activation. A pathway diagram indicates proposed causal connections, but experiments are needed to establish which connections operate in a particular context. Microscopy can visualize cell structures or labeled molecules, yet magnification merely enlarges an image while resolution determines whether nearby features can be distinguished. Fluorescent labels report the distribution of the label under the preparation conditions; fixation, overexpression or tagging can alter the system. Colocalization means signals occupy overlapping resolved regions, not necessarily that two molecules touch directly. Combine imaging with perturbations, controls and quantitative timing to test a signaling explanation. A change after treatment can reflect direct signaling, toxicity or an indirect cell-state shift, so alternatives must remain visible in the reasoning.
body.zh: 细胞信号始于刺激改变受体或其他感知分子。受体位置与结合特异性决定能检测何信号；不同细胞网络不同，同一信号可引起不同响应。转导通过蛋白作用、磷酸化、第二信使或基因表达传递信息，级联可放大小输入，反馈和终止防止无限活化。路径图表示拟议因果连接，需实验确认特定情境中哪些实际运作。显微可显示结构或标记分子，但放大仅增图尺寸，分辨率决定能否区分相邻特征。荧光报告制备条件下标签分布，固定、过表达或加标签可能扰动系统。共定位只说明信号在可分辨区域重叠，不一定直接接触。应结合扰动、对照和定量时间检验信号解释；处理后变化也可能源于毒性或间接状态改变。

summary.en: Integrated equilibrium problems combine acid–base, precipitation or complexation with shared material balances.
summary.zh: 综合平衡题把酸碱、沉淀或配位与共享物料守恒结合。

objectives.en: Explain speciation using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释物种分布。

objectives.en: Apply conservation equations and check validity checks.
objectives.zh: 应用守恒方程，并检查有效性检查。

body.en: Start a multi-equilibrium problem by identifying what was actually added, because analytical totals remain fixed even while species redistribute. A metal salt and a ligand can produce free metal, several complexes and possibly a precipitate; an acid–base ligand also changes form with pH. Write separate balances for total metal and total ligand, counting the number of ligand units in each complex. Add charge balance when the problem does not otherwise determine the hydrogen-ion concentration. Equilibrium constants connect free species, so substituting total metal directly into a formation constant generally gives an incorrect result. Choose a provisional dominant species only when the constants and available amounts support it. Solve the reduced equations, then calculate neglected fractions and compare with the required precision. Check whether precipitation is allowed by the resulting ion product, not merely by remembering that a salt is called insoluble. A physically acceptable solution has nonnegative concentrations, satisfies every conserved total and agrees with the assumed phase inventory. If two different approximations produce incompatible answers, the conflict is evidence to revisit assumptions rather than average the answers.
body.zh: 多重平衡先识别实际加入了什么：物种会重分布，分析总量仍守恒。金属盐与配体可产生游离金属、多种配合物甚至沉淀；酸碱配体还随 pH 改形态。分别写总金属和总配体守恒，注意每配合物所含配体数；若其他条件不能确定氢离子，补电荷守恒。平衡常数连接游离物种，把总金属直接代入生成常数通常错误。只有常数和库存支持时才能假设优势物种，解简化方程后计算被忽略比例并对照精度要求。沉淀是否允许应看最终离子积，而不是只背“难溶”。物理解须浓度非负、符合所有总量与相态假设。不同近似若矛盾，应重查假设，不能把答案平均。

summary.en: A structure puzzle combines atom inventory, unsaturation, symmetry and multiple spectra.
summary.zh: 结构题综合原子库存、不饱和度、对称性与多种光谱。

objectives.en: Explain formula constraints using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释分子式约束。

objectives.en: Apply signal equivalence and check candidate testing.
objectives.zh: 应用信号等价，并检查候选检验。

body.en: A molecular-structure puzzle is best treated as a constraint-satisfaction problem. Begin with the formula and charge, calculate an appropriate unsaturation count and list plausible functional-group combinations. An exact mass can distinguish formulas that have similar nominal masses, while isotope patterns can reveal characteristic elemental composition. Infrared evidence helps identify or exclude bond types, but overlapping bands and weak absorptions limit certainty. In proton NMR, integration gives relative proton counts and splitting reflects couplings under a stated model; chemically equivalent protons need not correspond one to one with peaks in a complex spectrum. Carbon NMR signal count can reveal symmetry or distinct carbon environments. Use the combined information to draw several candidate structures rather than committing immediately to the first familiar pattern. Test each candidate against every observation, including missing signals that should have been strong and detectable. Stereochemical information may require additional experiments beyond a simple one-dimensional spectrum. A good final explanation says how each major feature supports the proposed structure and why alternatives fail. If the supplied evidence cannot distinguish two candidates, identifying that underdetermination is stronger reasoning than inventing a unique answer.
body.zh: 结构题适合作为约束满足问题。先从分子式、电荷和不饱和度列可能官能团组合。准确质量可区分名义质量相近的式子，同位素模式可提示元素组成。红外帮助识别或排除键，但重叠与弱吸收限制确定性。氢谱积分给相对氢数，裂分在给定模型下反映耦合；复杂谱中化学等价氢不必与峰一一对应。碳谱信号数可揭示对称性与碳环境。综合数据画多个候选，不要见熟悉模式就立即定案。逐一检验全部观察，包括本应强且可检出却缺失的信号。立体信息可能需超出简单一维谱的实验。好的解释说明各主要特征如何支持候选、为何排除其他；若证据不足区分两候选，指出欠定比编造唯一答案更严谨。

body.en: A structure puzzle combines atom inventory, unsaturation, symmetry and multiple spectra. Equivalent nuclei can share signals, while integration constrains relative counts. Build candidates and test every reliable datum rather than guessing from one peak.

body.en: A proton NMR integral ratio is 3:2:1 and the molecule has 12 observed hydrogens. How many correspond to the largest signal? Apply the relation step by step: Scale = 12/(3+2+1) = 2; largest = 3 × 2 = 6 H. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 氢谱积分比 3:2:1，总可观测氢数 12，最大信号对应几个氢？逐步代入关系：Scale = 12/(3+2+1) = 2; largest = 3 × 2 = 6 H.并检查单位与假设。

objectives.zh: 应用选择性，并检查路线比较。

body.en: An Olympiad mechanism should account for the origin and destination of every atom that changes its bonding. Mark nucleophilic and electrophilic sites, identify plausible leaving groups and track proton transfers explicitly when they affect charge or reactivity. A carbocation, radical or anion intermediate must be justified by the proposed conditions rather than inserted simply because it is familiar. Check whether rearrangement or stereochemical constraints would produce additional products. In synthesis, work backward to useful disconnections, then verify the route forward with the actual functional groups present. A reagent that performs the desired transformation on an isolated model compound may attack another group in the target precursor. Compare routes by compatibility, selectivity, availability and cumulative yield rather than step count alone. Catalytic, stoichiometric and work-up reagents have different roles and should not be conflated. A formal arrow from starting material to product is not a complete route unless the intermediate states and reaction conditions are chemically plausible. When evidence is supplied, use product ratios, labeling, rate dependence or stereochemistry to discriminate mechanisms instead of presenting the most elaborate possible story.

body.en: A synthesis of thermodynamics and kinetics begins by separating the question of direction from the question of timescale. The sign of actual reaction Gibbs energy predicts whether a small forward change lowers the relevant potential under the stated conditions. The equilibrium constant describes the composition reached after sufficient equilibration, whereas rate constants determine how rapidly the system approaches that state. A catalyst can shorten the approach without changing the final equilibrium ratio. Temperature complicates the comparison because it changes both equilibrium preferences and kinetic barriers; an increased rate does not by itself imply increased equilibrium yield. In electrochemistry, a favorable reversible potential may coexist with slow electrode kinetics or large resistive losses. In competing reaction networks, the initially dominant product can differ from the more stable long-time product, motivating the distinction between kinetic and thermodynamic control under specified reversible conditions. Build an energy or free-energy diagram that distinguishes reactants, intermediates, transition states and products. The vertical difference between endpoints controls thermodynamic driving force, while the barrier measured from the relevant populated state influences the rate. Never substitute one of these differences for the other.
body.zh: 热力学与动力学综合首先区分方向和时间尺度。实际反应吉布斯能符号判断规定条件下小幅正向变化是否降低相应势。平衡常数描述充分平衡后的组成，速率常数决定接近平衡快慢。催化剂可缩短过程而不改变最终平衡比例。温度同时改变平衡偏好与势垒，因此速率增加不代表平衡产率增加。电化学中，有利可逆电势可与慢电极动力学或大电阻损失并存。竞争网络的初期主产物可不同于长期更稳定产物，在指定可逆条件下形成动力学与热力学控制区别。能量图应区分反应物、中间体、过渡态与产物；端点高度差控制热力学驱动力，从实际布居态量起的势垒影响速率，不能互相替代。

body.en: A practical-data problem asks why a procedure produces a trustworthy number, not merely which apparatus appears in a picture. For each operation, identify whether it establishes composition, removes an interference, preserves a sample or improves a measurement. Rinsing a transfer vessel can improve quantitative transfer, while rinsing a prepared precipitate has a different purpose and may cause dissolution loss if the solvent is unsuitable. Trace an error through the calculation equation to determine its direction: retained water increases a gravimetric mass, whereas incomplete recovery usually decreases it. The effect of a volume error depends on whether that volume is in a numerator, denominator or calibration step, so memorized “high” and “low” labels are unreliable. Distinguish a single blunder, a systematic method bias and random reading variation. Replicates characterize spread but do not automatically expose a shared bias. Compare controls, blanks and reference results to locate the likely failure stage. Report the supported conclusion and uncertainty without deleting inconvenient observations. Good analysis can explain why an apparently precise set of measurements is nevertheless not accurate.
body.zh: 实验数据题问操作为何产生可信数值，而不只是识图认仪器。每步应判断是在确定组成、去干扰、保存样品还是改善测量。冲洗转移容器改善定量转移，洗沉淀目的不同，溶剂不当还会造成溶失。沿计算式追踪误差方向：残水抬高重量结果，不完全回收通常降低。体积误差效果取决于它在分子、分母还是校准步骤，死记“偏高偏低”不可靠。区分单次粗差、系统偏倚与随机读数变异；重复反映分散，却不自动揭示共同偏差。结合对照、空白与标准结果定位失误阶段。如实报告结论和不确定度，不删不方便的观察。良好分析能解释看似精密的一组测量为何仍不准确。

body.en: An integrated chemistry set often introduces an unfamiliar compound, technique or historical experiment, but supplies enough information to reason from conservation and models already learned. First mark what is given, what is requested and which quantities connect the subparts. Translate prose into atom counts, charge balances, amount ratios or energy relations before attempting elaborate algebra. A later subproblem may remain solvable symbolically even if an earlier numerical answer is uncertain; preserve the dependency explicitly rather than inventing a value. Units provide a fast independent check, especially when moving among mass, moles, concentration, pressure and electrical charge. Estimate the expected sign and order of magnitude before accepting a calculator result. Separate a stated idealization from an experimentally demonstrated fact, and avoid adding unsupported chemical assumptions simply to force a neat answer. During review, check limiting reagents, equilibrium approximation validity, charge conservation and whether a structure satisfies every constraint. A clear derivation lets valid reasoning survive an arithmetic slip. After a timed set, classify mistakes by missing concept, misread condition, algebra, units or time allocation so the next practice session addresses their actual causes.
body.zh: 综合化学题常介绍陌生化合物、技术或历史实验，但通常给足信息，可用已学守恒和模型推理。先标已知、目标及子题间连接量，把文字转为原子数、电荷守恒、物质的量比或能量关系，再复杂运算。前题数值不确定时，后题常仍可符号求解，应保留依赖而非捏造数值。质量、摩尔、浓度、压强、电荷间转换时，单位提供快速独立检查；接受计算器结果前先估符号与数量级。区分题设理想化与已证实事实，不为凑整齐答案添加无依据化学假设。复查限量试剂、近似有效性、电荷与结构约束。清晰推导能让有效思路不被算术失误掩盖。限时后按概念缺失、误读、代数、单位或分配时间分类错误，使下次训练针对真实原因。

summary.en: Proteins join amino acids, nucleic acids join nucleotides, and many carbohydrates join sugars.

body.en: Biomolecules use a limited set of chemical groups to generate diverse structures and functions. Amino acids contain an amino group and carboxyl group attached to a side-chain-bearing carbon; their protonation states depend on pH. Peptide bonds join residues into a sequence with distinct amino and carboxyl ends. The sequence constrains folding, while hydrogen bonding, electrostatics, hydrophobic effects and dispersion help stabilize secondary and tertiary organization. Carbohydrates include simple sugars and linked polymers with different bond orientations, making starch and cellulose chemically similar in composition but functionally different. Lipids include fats, phospholipids and steroids; many are amphipathic, containing both water-compatible and hydrophobic regions. This property supports membrane assembly. Nucleotides combine a base, sugar and phosphate; nucleic-acid chains have directional sugar–phosphate backbones, with base sequences carrying information. Hydrolysis and condensation connect the construction and breakdown of these structures, but cells use specific activated intermediates and enzymes rather than relying on an abstract reverse reaction. A biomolecule’s function depends on shape, chemical environment and interactions, so knowing its monomer list alone is insufficient to explain its behavior.

body.en: An enzyme binds reactants in an active-site environment that can orient them, transfer protons, stabilize charge or form temporary covalent intermediates. Catalysis lowers the effective barrier along an available pathway; it does not supply a different overall equilibrium. Enzyme specificity is selective recognition, not necessarily absolute exclusivity for one molecule. In the simplest Michaelis–Menten scheme, substrate binds enzyme, the complex forms product and enzyme is regenerated. Under appropriate initial-rate and steady-state assumptions, the rate follows a saturating curve. Vmax scales with total active enzyme concentration, and kcat describes turnover per active enzyme at saturation. Km equals the substrate concentration at half Vmax within that model, but it is not always a direct dissociation constant or a universal measure of binding affinity. Inhibitors can alter apparent parameters differently depending on their binding mechanism. Irreversible loss of activity and allosteric regulation require additional descriptions. Temperature and pH affect both catalytic chemistry and protein structure, so an observed optimum reflects competing effects. Fit rate data with uncertainty and inspect whether the simple model actually captures the curve before assigning mechanistic meaning to its parameters.
body.zh: 酶的活性位点可定位反应物、转移质子、稳定电荷或形成暂时共价中间体。催化降低路径上的有效势垒，不改变总平衡。特异性是选择性识别，不一定绝对只接受一种分子。简单米氏方案中，底物结合酶，复合物生成产物并再生酶；在适当初速和稳态假设下，速率呈饱和曲线。Vmax 随活性酶总量变化，kcat 描述饱和下每个活性酶周转。Km 在该模型内等于半最大速率的底物浓度，但不总是解离常数或通用亲和尺度。抑制剂依结合机制改变表观参数，不可逆失活及变构调控需更多描述。温度与 pH 同时影响催化化学及蛋白结构，观测最适值反映竞争效应。应带不确定度拟合并检查模型是否真实描述曲线，再赋予参数机理意义。

body.en: Cells maintain organized, nonequilibrium states by exchanging matter and energy with their surroundings. A reaction’s actual Gibbs-energy change depends on cellular concentrations as well as its standard transformed value. ATP hydrolysis is useful because suitable enzymes can couple it to otherwise unfavorable processes through shared intermediates or conformational cycles. It is misleading to say that energy is released simply by breaking a high-energy bond: bond breaking costs energy, and the favorable overall change arises from the complete reactant-to-product transformation, including solvation and stabilization. ATP is therefore an energy-transfer currency that is continually regenerated, not a permanent one-way fuel store. Reducing cofactors such as NADH carry transferable electron equivalents, while ion gradients store electrochemical free energy across membranes. A gradient includes both a concentration contribution and an electrical contribution for charged species. ATP synthase couples ion movement to chemical synthesis through a molecular mechanism. Adding two favorable and unfavorable equations is only physically meaningful when an actual coupling pathway exists. Distinguish total energy conservation from the free-energy decrease that limits how much useful work a cell can extract.
body.zh: 细胞通过与环境交换物质能量维持有组织的非平衡态。实际反应吉布斯能不仅依赖标准转化值，也依赖细胞浓度。ATP 水解之所以有用，是酶能通过共同中间体或构象循环把它与不利过程耦合。“断高能键放能”容易误导，因为断键需要能量；有利总变化来自完整反应物到产物转化，包括溶剂化和稳定化。ATP 是持续再生的能量转移货币，不是永久单向燃料仓。NADH 等辅因子携带可转移还原当量，离子梯度跨膜储存电化学自由能；带电物种梯度兼有浓度和电势贡献。ATP 合酶以分子机理把离子流与合成耦合。只有存在真实耦合路径时，才能有物理意义地把有利和不利方程相加。能量总守恒与限制可提取有用功的自由能降低是不同概念。

body.en: Central metabolism is a connected network rather than one linear energy-production chain. Glycolysis converts a six-carbon glucose into two three-carbon pyruvate molecules while transferring electrons to a cofactor and producing a net ATP gain under the standard pathway bookkeeping. When oxidative metabolism is available, pyruvate can be converted to acetyl-CoA with carbon dioxide release and additional reducing-equivalent production. The citric-acid cycle oxidizes acetyl-derived carbon while regenerating its starting acceptor and supplying intermediates for biosynthesis. Electron carriers feed an electron-transport system whose favorable electron transfers can pump protons across a membrane. ATP synthesis then uses the resulting electrochemical gradient. Oxygen serves as the terminal acceptor in aerobic respiration, but glycolysis itself does not directly consume oxygen. Fermentation regenerates oxidized cofactor so glycolysis can continue without that respiratory route. Exact ATP yield per glucose depends on organism, transport costs, coupling efficiency and alternative pathways, so a single universal integer can mislead. Track carbon atoms, electron equivalents and energy transfers separately; their balances reveal different aspects of the same network and help detect inconsistent pathway summaries.
body.zh: 中心代谢是网络，不是单一产能直线。标准糖酵解把六碳葡萄糖变成两个三碳丙酮酸，同时向辅因子转移电子并净生成 ATP。有氧化代谢条件时，丙酮酸可转为乙酰辅酶 A，释放 CO2 并生成更多还原当量。柠檬酸循环氧化乙酰来源碳、再生起始受体，并提供合成前体。电子载体把电子送入传递系统，有利电子转移可跨膜泵质子，ATP 合成再利用电化学梯度。氧是有氧呼吸末端受体，但糖酵解本身不直接消耗氧。发酵再生氧化辅因子，使糖酵解无需该呼吸路径仍可继续。每葡萄糖 ATP 实际收益依生物、转运成本、耦合效率及替代路径变化，万能固定整数会误导。碳、还原当量和能量应分别核算，反映同一网络的不同方面。

body.en: Anabolic pathways assemble complex molecules from smaller precursors and usually consume energy and reducing power. They are not necessarily simple reversals of catabolic pathways: strongly favorable breakdown steps may require different enzymes and coupled reactions in the synthetic direction. Shared intermediates connect amino-acid, nucleotide, carbohydrate and lipid synthesis, so changing one branch can alter precursor availability elsewhere. Feedback inhibition allows an end product to reduce activity at an earlier pathway step, limiting unnecessary production. Covalent modification can switch enzyme activity on a short timescale, while changes in gene expression alter enzyme abundance more slowly. Substrate supply, cofactor ratios, transport and product removal can all control flux, so there need not be one permanently dominant rate-limiting enzyme. Compartmentation separates reactions into organelles or local environments with different concentrations and conditions. Reciprocal regulation helps avoid wasteful cycles in which synthesis and breakdown consume energy without useful net change, though some cycles can serve regulatory or heat-producing roles. Interpret a metabolic change by distinguishing altered enzyme amount, altered enzyme activity and changed metabolite availability rather than attributing every effect to one gene.
