body.en: The statement “Every occupied molecular orbital strengthens the bond equally.” is not valid. Antibonding electrons reduce the net bond order. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.
body.zh: 物理模型始于明确的系统与可测量的量。使用方程前，写出参考系、单位、边界条件和理想化假设。标量只有大小，矢量还具有方向。变化率描述单位时间内的改变，累积量则把区间内的贡献相加。守恒定律比较同一定义系统的不同时刻，必须计入穿过边界的转移。方程两侧必须具有相同量纲，但量纲一致并不能证明模型。应检查简单极限，并用独立证据检验预测，然后才谨慎推广。

text.zh: 中心力必然使速率恒定。

text.en: A central force conserves angular momentum about its centre.
text.zh: 中心力保持关于力心的角动量。

hints.en: Check the distinction explained under conditions and common errors.
hints.zh: 检查“成立条件与常见误区”中所说明的区别。

explanation.en: A central force conserves angular momentum about its centre. The statement “A central force necessarily keeps speed constant.” is not valid. A central force conserves angular momentum about its centre. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

summary.en: Canonical momentum is ∂L/∂q̇.
summary.zh: 正则动量为 ∂L/∂q̇。

objectives.en: Explain canonical momentum using the stated model.
objectives.zh: 用给定模型解释正则动量。

objectives.en: Apply hamiltonian and check phase space.
objectives.zh: 应用哈密顿量，并检查相空间。

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.
body.zh: 物理模型始于明确的系统与可测量的量。使用方程前，写出参考系、单位、边界条件和理想化假设。标量只有大小，矢量还具有方向。变化率描述单位时间内的改变，累积量则把区间内的贡献相加。守恒定律比较同一定义系统的不同时刻，必须计入穿过边界的转移。方程两侧必须具有相同量纲，但量纲一致并不能证明模型。应检查简单极限，并用独立证据检验预测，然后才谨慎推广。

title.zh: 正则动量 · 哈密顿量 · 相空间

body.en: Canonical momentum is ∂L/∂q̇. The Legendre transform H = Σpq̇ − L gives Hamilton’s equations q̇ = ∂H/∂p and ṗ = −∂H/∂q when the transformation is regular.
body.zh: 正则动量为 ∂L/∂q̇。勒让德变换 H = Σpq̇ − L 在正则条件下导出 q̇ = ∂H/∂p、ṗ = −∂H/∂q。

body.en: A free particle has H = p²/(2m), p = 6 and m = 3. Find q̇ = p/m. Apply the relation step by step: q̇ = p/m = 6/3 = 2. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 自由粒子 H = p²/(2m)，p = 6、m = 3，q̇ = p/m 为多少？逐步代入关系：q̇ = p/m = 6/3 = 2.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “A point in position space always determines the future motion uniquely.” is not valid. Phase space specifies coordinates and their conjugate momenta. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “仅知道位置空间的一点总能唯一确定未来运动。”并不成立。相空间同时指定坐标及其共轭动量。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Before applying the relation to a new situation, draw the system boundary and identify what is measured, what is inferred and what is assumed constant. Change one parameter and predict the direction of the result before calculating. This separates understanding of a model from memorizing one numerical answer. This introductory survey establishes the named ideas; extended derivations, laboratory competence and comprehensive examination preparation require further study and review.
body.zh: 把关系应用于新情境前，先确定系统边界，区分测量量、推断量以及假定不变的量。改变一个参数，先预测结果的变化方向，再计算。这能区分理解模型与记忆数值答案。本入门概览建立所列核心概念；完整推导、实验操作和全面考试训练仍需进一步学习与审核。

body.en: A uniform one-dimensional potential falls from 12 V to 4 V across 2 m. Find field magnitude in V/m. Apply the relation step by step: |E| = |ΔV|/Δx = 8/2 = 4 V/m. Check the units and the assumptions used.

body.en: Charges ±2 C are separated by 0.3 m. Find dipole moment magnitude in C·m. Apply the relation step by step: p = qd = 2 × 0.3 = 0.6 C·m. Check the units and the assumptions used.

body.en: The statement “Zero net charge means zero field everywhere.” is not valid. A neutral object can have a nonzero dipole field. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

body.en: Writing B = ∇×A automatically enforces zero magnetic divergence. Different vector potentials related by adding a gradient describe the same B; this is gauge freedom, not different measured magnetism.
body.zh: 写成 B = ∇×A 自动满足磁场散度为零。相差一个梯度的矢势给出同一 B，这是规范自由度，而非不同的实测磁场。

body.en: For A = (0, bx, 0), Bz = b. If b = 3 T, find Bz in T. Apply the relation step by step: Bz = ∂Ay/∂x − ∂Ax/∂y = b = 3 T. Check the units and the assumptions used.

body.en: A physical model starts with a clearly specified system and measurable quantities. Write down the reference frame, units, boundary conditions and idealizations before using an equation. A scalar has magnitude; a vector also has direction. A rate describes change per unit time, while an accumulated quantity adds contributions over an interval. Conservation laws compare the same defined system at different times and require accounting for transfers across its boundary. An equation is a relationship between quantities, so both sides must have the same dimensions. Dimensional agreement is necessary but cannot prove a model. Check a simple limiting case and compare a prediction with independent evidence before trusting an extrapolation.
body.zh: 物理模型始于明确的系统与可测量的量。使用方程前，写出参考系、单位、边界条件和理想化假设。标量只有大小，矢量还具有方向。变化率描述单位时间内的改变，累积量则把区间内的贡献相加。守恒定律比较同一定义系统的不同时刻，必须计入穿过边界的转移。方程两侧必须具有相同量纲，但量纲一致并不能证明模型。应检查简单极限，并用独立证据检验预测，然后才谨慎推广。

title.zh: 回归 · 残差结构 · 模型检验

body.en: A fit estimates parameters from data. Residuals are observed minus predicted values; systematic curvature or trends suggest missing physics, drift or an unsuitable error model. Small residuals alone do not establish causation.
body.zh: 拟合从数据估计参数。残差为观测值减预测值；系统弯曲或趋势可能提示遗漏物理、漂移或误差模型不当。残差小本身不能证明因果。

body.en: Observed value is 12 and fitted prediction is 9. Find residual. Apply the relation step by step: residual = observed − predicted = 12 − 9 = 3. Check the units and the assumptions used.
body.zh: 观测值为 12，拟合预测为 9，残差是多少？逐步代入关系：residual = observed − predicted = 12 − 9 = 3.并检查单位与假设。

body.en: The statement “A straight-line fit is valid for every data shape.” is not valid. Residual patterns can reveal a model’s inadequacy. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.
body.zh: “直线拟合适用于任何数据形状。”并不成立。残差模式可以揭示模型不足。将结果推广到例题以外之前，要明确物理假设。

body.en: Before applying the relation to a new situation, draw the system boundary and identify what is measured, what is inferred and what is assumed constant. Change one parameter and predict the direction of the result before calculating. This separates understanding of a model from memorizing one numerical answer. This introductory survey establishes the named ideas; extended derivations, laboratory competence and comprehensive examination preparation require further study and review.
body.zh: 把关系应用于新情境前，先确定系统边界，区分测量量、推断量以及假定不变的量。改变一个参数，先预测结果的变化方向，再计算。这能区分理解模型与记忆数值答案。本入门概览建立所列核心概念；完整推导、实验操作和全面考试训练仍需进一步学习与审核。

body.en: Energy and momentum provide complementary descriptions of motion. Kinetic energy is a scalar, mv²/2 for a nonrelativistic particle, while momentum is the vector mv. External work changes kinetic energy; external impulse changes total momentum. Choose a system before deciding which interactions are internal. Internal forces may redistribute energy or momentum without changing an isolated system’s total momentum. Mechanical energy is conserved only when nonconservative transfers are absent or explicitly included. Keep rotational and translational motion distinct, and always specify the axis for angular quantities.

body.en: Energy and momentum provide complementary descriptions of motion. Kinetic energy is a scalar, mv²/2 for a nonrelativistic particle, while momentum is the vector mv. External work changes kinetic energy; external impulse changes total momentum. Choose a system before deciding which interactions are internal. Internal forces may redistribute energy or momentum without changing an isolated system’s total momentum. Mechanical energy is conserved only when nonconservative transfers are absent or explicitly included. Keep rotational and translational motion distinct, and always specify the axis for angular quantities.
body.zh: 能量与动量提供互补的运动描述。非相对论质点的动能为标量 mv²/2，动量则为矢量 mv。外力做功改变动能，外力冲量改变总动量。判断内外相互作用前先选系统。内力可以重新分配能量或动量，但不会改变孤立系统总动量。只有不存在非保守能量转移，或已将其计入时，才能正确使用能量守恒。要区分平动和转动，并明确角量所对应的轴。

title.zh: 冲量 · 动量守恒 · 弹性程度

body.en: Impulse is force integrated over time, or average force times duration. In an isolated collision total momentum is conserved; kinetic energy is also conserved only for an elastic collision. Sticking collisions are perfectly inelastic.
body.zh: 冲量是力对时间的积分，也可用平均力乘作用时间。孤立碰撞中总动量守恒；只有弹性碰撞还保持总动能不变。碰后粘在一起的碰撞称完全非弹性碰撞。

body.en: A 2 kg cart at 3 m/s sticks to a stationary 1 kg cart. The common speed is 6/3 = 2 m/s.
body.zh: 2 kg 小车以 3 m/s 撞上静止的 1 kg 小车并粘合，共同速度为 6/3 = 2 m/s。

body.en: A force law together with an equation of motion predicts a system’s evolution. In gravity the inverse-square dependence concerns distance from the attracting mass centre. In fluids, pressure is normal force per unit area and depends on depth at rest. For oscillations, displacement is measured from equilibrium and a restoring effect points back toward that equilibrium. Density is mass divided by volume, while frequency counts cycles per second. Distinguish equilibrium, steady flow and periodic motion: each has different simplifying assumptions and different conserved quantities.
body.zh: 力的规律与运动方程共同决定系统演化。引力的平方反比关系使用到吸引质量中心的距离。流体中的压强是单位面积法向力，静止时随深度改变。振动位移从平衡位置量起，回复作用指向平衡位置。密度是质量除以体积，频率是每秒周期数。要区分平衡、稳定流动与周期运动，因为它们的简化假设和守恒量不同。

body.en: Newtonian gravity has magnitude GMm/r². For a circular orbit it supplies mv²/r, giving v² = GM/r. Gravitational potential energy referenced to infinity is −GMm/r.
body.zh: 牛顿引力大小为 GMm/r²。圆轨道中它提供 mv²/r，因此 v² = GM/r。以无穷远为零点时，引力势能为 −GMm/r。

body.en: Doubling orbital radius reduces gravitational force to one quarter, not one half.
body.zh: 轨道半径加倍时，引力减至四分之一，而不是一半。

body.en: The statement “Orbiting bodies experience no gravity.” is not valid. An orbit is continuous free fall with sufficient sideways motion. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

body.en: A displaced volume of 0.002 m³ of water has mass 2 kg and buoyancy 20 N if g = 10 m/s².

body.en: The statement “Buoyancy always equals the object’s weight.” is not valid. Buoyancy depends on displaced fluid volume and density. State the physical assumptions before extending this result beyond the example.

body.en: Mechanics describes how positions change and why changes of velocity occur. Choose a system, an origin, a positive direction and a clock before writing equations. A particle model ignores size and rotation when these do not affect the question. A vector carries direction as well as magnitude; its components are signed numbers along chosen axes. Mass measures inertia in kilograms. Force is an interaction measured in newtons, where one newton equals one kilogram metre per second squared. Equations describe these quantities, not merely numbers.
body.zh: 力学研究位置怎样改变，以及速度为何改变。列式前先选定系统、原点、正方向和时钟。当大小和转动不影响问题时，可以使用质点模型。矢量同时具有大小与方向；分量是沿选定坐标轴的带符号数。质量用千克表示，衡量惯性。力描述相互作用，单位牛顿；一牛顿等于一千克米每二次方秒。方程描述的是这些物理量，而不只是数字。

title.en: Position and displacement · Velocity and acceleration · Constant-acceleration conditions
title.zh: 位置与位移 · 速度与加速度 · 匀加速条件

body.en: Displacement is final position minus initial position. Average velocity divides displacement by elapsed time; average speed instead uses total path length. Acceleration is velocity change per time. When acceleration is constant, v = u + at and displacement s = ut + at²/2. The signs must refer to the same axis throughout.
body.zh: 位移等于末位置减初位置。平均速度用位移除以时间；平均速率则使用总路程。加速度是速度随时间的变化。加速度恒定时，v = u + at，位移 s = ut + at²/2。所有正负号必须始终对应同一坐标轴。

body.en: Starting from rest with a = 2 m/s² for 3 s gives v = 6 m/s and s = 9 m. The velocity–time graph is a straight line; its triangular area is also 9 m.
body.zh: 从静止开始，以 2 m/s² 加速 3 s，末速度为 6 m/s，位移为 9 m。速度—时间图像是一条直线，其下三角形面积同样为 9 m。

body.en: Negative acceleration need not mean slowing down: negative velocity becoming more negative increases speed. The constant-acceleration equations fail when acceleration varies.
body.zh: 负加速度不一定表示减速：负速度变得更负时，速率反而增加。加速度变化时不能直接套用匀加速公式。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.
body.zh: 同一运动可以用语言、图示、图像和方程表示。各表示之间相互一致，是有效的独立检查。微积分以后将用瞬时变化率代替区间平均量。

prompt.zh: 从静止开始，以 3 m/s² 匀加速 4 s，位移为多少米？

title.en: Vector components · Projectile motion · Independent axes
title.zh: 矢量分量 · 抛体运动 · 各轴独立

body.en: Resolve position, velocity and acceleration along perpendicular axes. Without air resistance near Earth, a projectile has constant horizontal velocity and downward acceleration g. Horizontal and vertical motions share the same time, which links their equations. In three dimensions a third independent component is added; vector magnitude uses the square root of the sum of squared components.
body.zh: 把位置、速度和加速度分解到互相垂直的坐标轴。近地面忽略空气阻力时，抛体水平速度恒定，竖直加速度为向下的 g。两个方向共用同一个时间，由此联系方程。三维情形增加第三个分量；矢量大小等于各分量平方和的平方根。

body.en: A horizontal launch at 8 m/s falls for 2 s, travelling 16 m horizontally. With g = 10 m/s² it drops 20 m. Combining displacements gives a diagonal displacement, not the curved path length.
body.zh: 水平以 8 m/s 抛出，飞行 2 s 后水平前进 16 m。取 g = 10 m/s²，下降 20 m。分位移合成得到斜向总位移，而不是弯曲轨迹的路程。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical positions are independent equations, but the elapsed time is shared. Air resistance would couple motion through the velocity-dependent force.
body.zh: 水平与竖直位置分别列式，但时间相同。若考虑空气阻力，依赖速度的阻力会使运动分量发生耦合。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.
body.zh: 同一运动可以用语言、图示、图像和方程表示。各表示之间相互一致，是有效的独立检查。微积分以后将用瞬时变化率代替区间平均量。

title.zh: 惯性 · 合力 · 作用力与反作用力

body.en: In an inertial frame, zero net force means constant velocity. Newton’s second law is the vector equation ΣF = ma for constant mass. Draw only forces acting on the chosen body. Newton’s third law pairs equal opposite forces on different bodies; these do not cancel within a single body’s force diagram.
body.zh: 在惯性系中，合力为零意味着速度恒定。质量恒定时，牛顿第二定律为矢量方程 ΣF = ma。受力图只画作用在所选物体上的力。第三定律的一对等大反向力作用在不同物体上，不会在单个物体的受力图中互相抵消。

body.en: A 2 kg cart pulled right with 7 N and left with 3 N has net force 4 N right, hence acceleration 2 m/s² right. Its current velocity may nevertheless point left.
body.zh: 2 kg 小车受到向右 7 N、向左 3 N 的力，合力为向右 4 N，因此加速度向右，为 2 m/s²；此时速度仍可能向左。

body.en: A force changes velocity, not necessarily position in its own direction immediately. Weight and normal force are not a third-law pair because both act on one body.
body.zh: 力改变速度，并不保证物体立即沿力的方向运动。重力与支持力都作用在同一物体上，因此不是第三定律力对。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.
body.zh: 同一运动可以用语言、图示、图像和方程表示。各表示之间相互一致，是有效的独立检查。微积分以后将用瞬时变化率代替区间平均量。

title.en: Normal force · Static friction · Kinetic friction
title.zh: 支持力 · 静摩擦 · 滑动摩擦

body.en: A normal force is perpendicular to a contact surface. Static friction adjusts to prevent relative slipping up to |f| ≤ μsN; it is not always at that limit. In a simple dry-contact model, sliding friction has magnitude μkN and opposes relative sliding. Surface geometry and other forces determine N.
body.zh: 支持力垂直于接触面。静摩擦力会调整大小以阻止相对滑动，但满足 |f| ≤ μsN，并非总等于最大值。简单干摩擦模型中，滑动摩擦力大小为 μkN，方向与相对滑动相反。支持力 N 由表面几何和其他力共同决定。

body.en: A horizontal 10 N push on a stationary box is balanced by 10 N static friction if the maximum is 15 N. A 20 N push exceeds that limit and slipping begins in this idealized model.
body.zh: 若最大静摩擦力为 15 N，水平推力 10 N 会被 10 N 静摩擦力平衡。若推力增为 20 N，则超过极限，在此理想模型中开始滑动。

body.en: Friction opposes relative slipping or its tendency, not necessarily the centre-of-mass velocity. A driven wheel can receive forward static friction.
body.zh: 摩擦力阻碍相对滑动或滑动趋势，不一定与质心速度相反。主动轮可以受到向前的静摩擦力。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.
body.zh: 同一运动可以用语言、图示、图像和方程表示。各表示之间相互一致，是有效的独立检查。微积分以后将用瞬时变化率代替区间平均量。

prompt.zh: 滑动物体受到 40 N 支持力，μk = 0.25，摩擦力大小为多少 N？

title.en: Centripetal acceleration · Radial force balance · Constraint forces
title.zh: 向心加速度 · 径向受力平衡 · 约束力

body.en: Uniform circular motion changes direction even when speed is constant. The inward acceleration is v²/r. “Centripetal force” names the inward resultant, not an additional interaction: tension, gravity or contact forces can supply it. A rope constrains length only while taut, and a track can push only where contact persists.
body.zh: 匀速圆周运动虽速率恒定，方向却持续变化，向内加速度为 v²/r。“向心力”是径向合力的名称，不是额外的一种相互作用；绳力、重力或接触力都可以提供它。绳只有绷紧时才能约束长度，轨道只有保持接触时才能施加推力。

body.en: For a 1 kg object moving at 4 m/s around a radius of 2 m, the inward resultant is 8 N. If speed doubles at fixed radius, the required force becomes four times larger.
body.zh: 1 kg 物体以 4 m/s 绕半径 2 m 的圆运动，向内合力为 8 N。半径不变而速率加倍时，所需向心力增为四倍。

body.en: Do not add an extra centripetal force to the real forces. Check positive tension or normal force; a negative result means the assumed constraint has failed.
body.zh: 不要在真实作用力之外再添加一个向心力。必须检查张力或支持力非负；算得负值说明原先假定的约束无法维持。

body.en: The same motion can be represented by words, a diagram, a graph and equations. Agreement between these representations is a useful independent check. Calculus later replaces interval averages with instantaneous rates.
body.zh: 同一运动可以用语言、图示、图像和方程表示。各表示之间相互一致，是有效的独立检查。微积分以后将用瞬时变化率代替区间平均量。
